+'use client';
+
+import { ArrowUpRight } from 'lucide-react';
+import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
+
+/** A real contact anchor before hydration, the same persistent enquiry everywhere after it. */
+export function HomepageEnquiryLink({ children, id, className = 'ah-button' }: {
+    readonly children: ReactNode;
+    readonly id?: string;
+    readonly className?: string;
+}) {
+    return <a id={id} className={className} href="#contact" onClick={(event) => {
+        event.preventDefault();
+        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('open-qualification-popup'));
+    }}>{children}<ArrowUpRight size={17} aria-hidden="true" /></a>;
+}

+import { MinimalFooter } from '@/components/minimal-footer';

+'use client';
+
+import { useRef, type ReactNode } from 'react';
+
+export function HomepageMobileNavigation({ label, children }: { readonly label: string; readonly children: ReactNode }) {
+    const reference = useRef<HTMLDetailsElement>(null);
+    return <details ref={reference} className="ah-mobile-navigation" onClick={(event) => {
+        if (event.target instanceof Element && event.target.closest('a')) reference.current?.removeAttribute('open');
+    }}><summary aria-label={label}><span /><span /></summary>{children}</details>;
+}
diff --git a/businesses/homepage/HomepagePage.tsx b/businesses/homepage/HomepagePage.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..a008995f5572794b07855fc2fb007ba334728cbf
--- /dev/null
+++ b/businesses/homepage/HomepagePage.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,97 @@
+import Image from 'next/image';
+import Link from 'next/link';
+import { ArrowRight, ArrowUpRight, Compass, SlidersHorizontal, Eye } from 'lucide-react';
+import { Footer } from '@/components/footer';
+import { QualificationPopup } from '@/components/qualification-popup';
+import { createPublicUrl } from '@/lib/domains/publicDomainRouting';
+import type { SupportedHomepageLanguage } from '@/lib/homepage-language';
+import { PRO_FIRMY_PATH } from '@/businesses/pro-firmy/config';
+import { WHITEPAPER_PATHS } from '@/businesses/whitepaper/whitepaperConfig';
+import { HOMEPAGE_CONTENT } from './homepageContent';
+import { HOMEPAGE_SCENARIOS } from './homepageScenarios';
+import { getHomepageEnquiry } from './homepageEnquiry';
+import { HomepageEnquiryLink } from './HomepageEnquiryLink';
+import HomepageStory from './HomepageStory';
+import { HomepageStoryBoundary } from './HomepageStoryBoundary';
+import { HomepageMobileNavigation } from './HomepageMobileNavigation';
+import './homepage.css';
+
+const OWNERSHIP_ICONS = [Compass, SlidersHorizontal, Eye];
+
+/** The business homepage owns its words and sections; the company-data offer remains independent. */
+export function HomepagePage({ language }: { readonly language: SupportedHomepageLanguage }) {
+    const content = HOMEPAGE_CONTENT[language];
+    const whitepaperUrl = createPublicUrl(WHITEPAPER_PATHS[language]);
+    const companyUrl = createPublicUrl(PRO_FIRMY_PATH);
+    const navigation = [
+        { href: '#agendas', label: content.examples },
+        { href: '#control', label: content.control },
+        { href: whitepaperUrl, label: 'Whitepaper' },
+    ];
+    const navigationLinks = navigation.map((item) => <a key={item.href} href={item.href}>{item.label}</a>);
+
+    return <div className="ah-page" lang={language}>
+        <a className="ah-skip" href="#homepage-main">{content.skip}</a>
+        <header className="ah-header">
+            <div className="ah-header-inner">

'Česky' : 'English'} aria-current={candidate === language ? 'page' : undefined}>{candidate === 'cs' ? 'CZ' : 'EN'}</Link>)}

+                    const Icon = OWNERSHIP_ICONS[index];

+            </section>

+        <QualificationPopup language={language} presentation={getHomepageEnquiry(language)} />

diff --git a/businesses/homepage/HomepageSceneMotion.tsx b/businesses/homepage/HomepageSceneMotion.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..daa7ea3c097913122b9115e6550a1c1c3911ca31
--- /dev/null
+++ b/businesses/homepage/HomepageSceneMotion.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+'use client';
+
+import { useMotionValueEvent, useScroll } from 'framer-motion';
+import { useEffect, type RefObject } from 'react';
+
+/** Optional presentation only. Scroll never chooses a story step or changes its meaning. */
+export default function HomepageSceneMotion({ sceneReference }: { readonly sceneReference: RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null> }) {
+    const { scrollYProgress } = useScroll({ target: sceneReference, offset: ['start end', 'end start'] });
+    const applyDepth = (progress: number) => {
+        sceneReference.current?.style.setProperty('--ah-tilt', `${12 - progress * 12}deg`);
+        sceneReference.current?.style.setProperty('--ah-lift', `${progress * -24}px`);
+    };
+    useMotionValueEvent(scrollYProgress, 'change', applyDepth);
+    useEffect(() => {
+        applyDepth(scrollYProgress.get());
+        // The controller is unmounted offscreen, in hidden tabs and for reduced motion.
+        // Preserve the last still frame; do not run catch-up animations on return.
+    });
+    return null;
+}
diff --git a/businesses/homepage/HomepageStory.tsx b/businesses/homepage/HomepageStory.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..8f789381756d4807b71e671107c8da40d36e9d68
--- /dev/null
+++ b/businesses/homepage/HomepageStory.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,71 @@
+'use client';
+
+import dynamic from 'next/dynamic';
+import { ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';
+import { useInView, useReducedMotion } from 'framer-motion';
+import { useEffect, useReducer, useRef, useState } from 'react';
+import type { SupportedHomepageLanguage } from '@/lib/homepage-language';
+import { HOMEPAGE_CONTENT } from './homepageContent';
+import { HOMEPAGE_SCENARIOS } from './homepageScenarios';
+import { homepageStoryReducer, INITIAL_HOMEPAGE_STORY } from './homepageStoryModel';
+import { HomepageArtifact, HomepageStatus } from './HomepageArtifact';
+import { HomepageEnquiryLink } from './HomepageEnquiryLink';
+
+const HomepageSceneMotion = dynamic(() => import('./HomepageSceneMotion'), { ssr: false });
+
+export default function HomepageStory({ language }: { readonly language: SupportedHomepageLanguage }) {
+    const content = HOMEPAGE_CONTENT[language];
+    const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(homepageStoryReducer, INITIAL_HOMEPAGE_STORY);
+    const [isInteractive, setIsInteractive] = useState(false);
+    const [isDocumentVisible, setIsDocumentVisible] = useState(false);
+    const sceneReference = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
+    const isInView = useInView(sceneReference);
+    const isReducedMotion = useReducedMotion();
+    useEffect(() => {
+        setIsInteractive(true);
+        const updateVisibility = () => setIsDocumentVisible(document.visibilityState === 'visible');
+        updateVisibility();
+        document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', updateVisibility);
+        return () => document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', updateVisibility);
+    }, []);
+
+    const scenario = HOMEPAGE_SCENARIOS[language].find((candidate) => candidate.id === state.scenarioId)!;
+    const step = scenario.steps[state.stepIndex];
+    const selectStep = (stepIndex: number) => dispatch({ type: 'step', stepIndex });
+
+    return <div className="ah-experience" data-testid="homepage-story" data-scenario={scenario.id} data-step={state.stepIndex}>
+        <div className="ah-scenario-picker" role="group" aria-label={content.story.choose}>
+            {HOMEPAGE_SCENARIOS[language].map((candidate, index) => <button key={candidate.id} type="button" aria-pressed={candidate.id === scenario.id} aria-controls="homepage-story-panel" disabled={!isInteractive} onClick={() => dispatch({ type: 'select', scenarioId: candidate.id })}>
+                <span aria-hidden="true">0{index + 1}</span>{candidate.name}
+            </button>)}
+        </div>
+        <div id="homepage-story-panel" className="ah-story-panel" ref={sceneReference}>
+            <div className="ah-story-copy">
+                <p className="ah-eyebrow">{content.story.scope}</p>
+                <h3>{scenario.benefit}</h3>
+                <p>{scenario.entrusted}</p>
+                <HomepageEnquiryLink className="ah-text-link">{content.cta}</HomepageEnquiryLink>
+            </div>
+            <HomepageArtifact scenario={scenario} step={step} content={content.story} isInteractive={isInteractive} onStep={selectStep} />
+            {isInteractive && isInView && isDocumentVisible && !isReducedMotion && <HomepageSceneMotion sceneReference={sceneReference} />}
+        </div>
+        <div className="ah-story-bottom">
+            <div className="ah-story-steps" role="group" aria-label={content.story.steps}>
+                {scenario.steps.map((candidate, index) => <button key={index} type="button" disabled={!isInteractive} aria-pressed={index === state.stepIndex} aria-controls="homepage-step-detail" onClick={() => selectStep(index)}><span>{index + 1}</span>{candidate.label}</button>)}
+            </div>
+            <div id="homepage-step-detail" className="ah-step-detail" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true">
+                <div><HomepageStatus status={step.status}>{step.statusLabel}</HomepageStatus><h4>{step.title}</h4><p>{step.description}</p></div>
+                <div className="ah-step-result"><span>{content.story.result}</span><strong>{step.result}</strong></div>
+            </div>
+            <div className="ah-story-toolbar">
+                <span className="ah-demo-label">{content.story.demo}</span>
+                <div className="ah-story-actions">
+                    <button type="button" disabled={!isInteractive} onClick={() => dispatch({ type: 'replay' })} aria-label={content.story.replay} title={content.story.replay}><RotateCcw size={17} aria-hidden="true" /></button>
+                    <button type="button" disabled={!isInteractive || state.stepIndex === 0} onClick={() => dispatch({ type: 'previous' })} aria-label={content.story.previous}><ArrowLeft size={18} aria-hidden="true" /></button>
+                    <span className="ah-step-count" aria-hidden="true">{state.stepIndex + 1} / {scenario.steps.length}</span>
+                    <button type="button" disabled={!isInteractive || state.stepIndex === scenario.steps.length - 1} onClick={() => dispatch({ type: 'next' })} aria-label={content.story.next}><ArrowRight size={18} aria-hidden="true" /></button>
+                </div>
+            </div>
+        </div>
+    </div>;
+}
diff --git a/businesses/homepage/HomepageStoryBoundary.tsx b/businesses/homepage/HomepageStoryBoundary.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..f576f9d9b2c98df18423c167883cf8893f74cb39
--- /dev/null
+++ b/businesses/homepage/HomepageStoryBoundary.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+'use client';
+
+import { Component, type ReactNode } from 'react';
+
+/** The server-rendered summaries and enquiry are outside this optional interactive island. */
+export class HomepageStoryBoundary extends Component<{ readonly children: ReactNode; readonly fallback: string }, { readonly isFailed: boolean }> {
+    state = { isFailed: false };
+    static getDerivedStateFromError() { return { isFailed: true }; }
+    render() {
+        return this.state.isFailed ? <p className="ah-story-fallback" role="status"><a href="#agenda-summaries">{this.props.fallback}</a></p> : this.props.children;
+    }
+}

+.ah-text-link svg { flex: none; }

+.ah-task { display: block; position: absolute; z-index: 3; bottom: 15px; right: 0; width: 245px; min-height: 108px; padding: 17px 20px; text-align: left; transform: translateZ(70px); border-radius: 17px; border: 1px solid #fff; background: #fffffffa; box-shadow: 0 18px 36px #2f5b7224; }
+.ah-task strong { display: block; margin-top: 10px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.5; }

+.ah-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.4; font-weight: 500; color: #25665f; }
+.ah-status svg { flex: none; }

+.ah-status[data-status="continuing"] { color: #226b99; }
+.ah-artifact-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 12px; background: #e8f2f5; color: #45809a; margin-bottom: 12px; }
+.ah-artifact-title { display: block; font-size: 22px; line-height: 1.2; font-family: var(--font-outfit), sans-serif; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -.03em; }

+.ah-document-list > span > svg:last-child { margin-left: auto; color: #658d82; }
+.ah-story-bottom { padding: 8px 38px 19px; background: #fff; border-top: 1px solid #e1e9ef; }

+.ah-story-steps button { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; font-size: 11px; min-height: 44px; color: #627681; text-align: left; }

+.ah-story-steps button[aria-pressed="true"] { color: #155775; font-weight: 600; }

+.ah-step-result { border-left: 1px solid #dce8ed; padding: 6px 0 6px 28px; margin-block: 12px 23px; align-self: center; }

+.ah-comparison-row[data-is-agenda="true"] :is(h3, li) { color: #156581; }

+.ah-control-cards article > svg { color: #4b8199; }

+.ah-closing { text-align: center; padding-block: 100px 75px; }

+.ah-closing > p:not(.ah-eyebrow) { max-width: 620px; margin-inline: auto; color: var(--ah-muted); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; }
+.ah-people { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 15px; margin-top: 35px; font-size: 11px; color: #6a808b; }
+.ah-people > div { display: flex; }
+.ah-people img { border-radius: 50%; background: #edf2f5; border: 2px solid #fff; }
+.ah-people img + img { margin-left: -9px; }
+.ah-depth { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 60px; padding-block: 30px 55px; border-top: 1px solid var(--ah-line); }
+.ah-depth > div + div { padding-left: 50px; border-left: 1px solid var(--ah-line); }
+.ah-depth h2 { font-size: 19px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -.02em; }
+.ah-depth p { font-size: 12px; color: var(--ah-muted); line-height: 1.8; margin-block: 10px 6px; max-width: 350px; }
+.ah-depth .ah-text-link { font-size: 12px; }
+.ah-page footer { background: #f5f8fa; color: #244152; }

+.ah-page footer img.filter { filter: none; }
+.ah-enquiry { display: block; max-height: calc(100dvh - 48px - var(--cookie-banner-height, 0px)); overflow-y: auto; border-radius: 24px; border-color: #dce5ea; padding: 30px; }

+.ah-enquiry-fields { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 0 15px; }

+@media (max-width: 1000px) {

+    .ah-step-result strong { font-size: 19px; }
+    .ah-story-toolbar { flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 7px; margin-top: 12px; }
+    .ah-demo-label { font-size: 8px; }

+    .ah-step-count { min-width: 25px; }
+    .ah-vision-note { font-size: 10px; max-width: 420px; padding-inline: 5px; }
+    .ah-summaries { margin-top: 15px; }

+    .ah-comparison-row h3 { font-size: 11px; margin-bottom: 19px; }
+    .ah-comparison-row ol { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 14px; }
+    .ah-comparison-row li { font-size: 11px; align-items: flex-start; gap: 7px; line-height: 1.6; }
+    .ah-comparison-row svg { width: 13px; margin-top: 2px; }

+    .ah-control-cards article { padding: 25px; }
+    .ah-control-cards h3 { font-size: 24px; margin-top: 20px; }
+    .ah-closing { padding-block: 65px 50px; }
+    .ah-closing h2 { font-size: 40px; }
+    .ah-closing > p:not(.ah-eyebrow) { font-size: 14px; }
+    .ah-people { flex-direction: column; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.7; gap: 10px; }
+    .ah-depth { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 25px; padding-bottom: 40px; }
+    .ah-depth > div + div { padding: 25px 0 0; border-left: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--ah-line); }
+    .ah-enquiry { padding: 23px; max-height: calc(100dvh - 32px); }
+    .ah-enquiry :is(input, select, textarea) { font-size: 16px; }
+    .ah-enquiry-fields { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 0; }
+}
+@media (max-width: 360px) {
+    .ah-container { width: calc(100% - 28px); }
+    .ah-header-inner { width: calc(100% - 28px); }
+    .ah-hero h1 { font-size: 36px; }

+    .ah-story-bottom { padding-inline: 14px; }
+    .ah-site-layout strong { font-size: 20px; }
+    .ah-site-sculpture { width: 45px; }
+    .ah-story-copy h3 { font-size: 28px; }
+}
+@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
+    html:has(.ah-page) { scroll-behavior: auto; }
+    .ah-page *, .ah-page *::before, .ah-page *::after, .ah-enquiry { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; }
+    .ah-scene-stack { transform: rotateX(5deg) rotateY(-5deg) !important; }
+}

+import type { QualificationEnquiryPresentation } from '@/components/qualification-enquiry';
+import type { SupportedHomepageLanguage } from '@/lib/homepage-language';
+import { HOMEPAGE_SCENARIOS } from './homepageScenarios';
+
+export function getHomepageEnquiry(language: SupportedHomepageLanguage): QualificationEnquiryPresentation {
+    const content = HOMEPAGE_ENQUIRY_CONTENT[language];
+    return {
+        ...content,
+        enquiryKind: 'autonomous-agenda',
+        agendaOptions: [...HOMEPAGE_SCENARIOS[language].map((scenario) => scenario.name), content.otherAgenda],
+        successUrl: `/dekujeme?source=autonomous-agendas&lang=${language}`,
+        fields: [
+            { id: 'name', label: content.name, type: 'text', autoComplete: 'name', isRequired: true },
+            { id: 'company', label: content.company, type: 'text', autoComplete: 'organization', isRequired: true },
+            { id: 'email', label: content.email, type: 'email', autoComplete: 'email', isRequired: true },
+            { id: 'phone', label: content.phone, type: 'tel', autoComplete: 'tel', isRequired: false },
+        ],
+    };
+}
+
+const HOMEPAGE_ENQUIRY_CONTENT = {

+++ b/businesses/homepage/homepageMetadata.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,25 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import { HOMEPAGE_METADATA, HOMEPAGE_PAGE_DEFINITIONS, HOMEPAGE_SOCIAL_PREVIEW_OPTIONS } from './homepageMetadata';
+import { PRO_FIRMY_METADATA } from '@/businesses/pro-firmy/proFirmyMetadata';
+import { resolveSocialPreviewImagePath } from '@/lib/metadata/social-preview-image-path';
+import { INDEXED_PAGE_METADATA_DEFINITIONS } from '@/lib/metadata/page-registry';
+
+describe('autonomous responsibility homepage metadata', () => {
+    it.each(['cs', 'en'] as const)('owns localized positioning and a new card while preserving routes (%s)', (language) => {
+        const definition = HOMEPAGE_PAGE_DEFINITIONS[language];
+        const metadata = HOMEPAGE_METADATA[language];
+        expect(metadata.alternates?.canonical).toBe(`https://ptbk.io/${language}`);
+        expect(metadata.alternates?.languages).toMatchObject({ cs: 'https://ptbk.io/cs', en: 'https://ptbk.io/en' });
+        expect(INDEXED_PAGE_METADATA_DEFINITIONS).toContain(definition);
+        expect(metadata.openGraph?.images).toEqual(metadata.twitter?.images);
+        expect(JSON.stringify(metadata)).not.toMatch(/halucin|hallucinat|100%|virtual employee|virtuální zaměstnanec|Instant access|Okamžitý přístup/);
+        expect(HOMEPAGE_SOCIAL_PREVIEW_OPTIONS[language]).toMatchObject({ artwork: 'agenda', hostname: 'ptbk.io', title: definition.socialTitle });
+        expect(resolveSocialPreviewImagePath(definition)).toBe(`/${language}/opengraph-image?v=2&content=agendas-1`);
+    });
+    it('keeps the preserved offer and authored previews independent of the homepage revision', () => {
+        expect(PRO_FIRMY_METADATA.alternates?.canonical).toBe('https://ptbk.io/cs/pro-firmy');
+        expect(JSON.stringify(PRO_FIRMY_METADATA)).toContain('virtuálního zaměstnance');
+        expect(JSON.stringify(PRO_FIRMY_METADATA)).not.toContain('agendas-1');
+        expect(resolveSocialPreviewImagePath({ ...HOMEPAGE_PAGE_DEFINITIONS.en, socialPreviewImagePath: '/authored.png' })).toBe('/authored.png');
+    });
+});

new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..66bb89d46e6aa4d9c651472144b4133540b6e57e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/businesses/homepage/homepageStory.test.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,82 @@
+// @vitest-environment jsdom
+import '@testing-library/jest-dom/vitest';
+import { cleanup, fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
+import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import { renderToStaticMarkup } from 'react-dom/server';
+import HomepageStory from './HomepageStory';
+import { HomepageStoryBoundary } from './HomepageStoryBoundary';
+import { HOMEPAGE_SCENARIOS } from './homepageScenarios';
+import { HOMEPAGE_CONTENT } from './homepageContent';
+import { homepageStoryReducer, INITIAL_HOMEPAGE_STORY } from './homepageStoryModel';
+
+vi.mock('framer-motion', () => ({ useInView: () => false, useReducedMotion: () => true }));
+vi.mock('next/dynamic', () => ({ default: () => () => null }));
+afterEach(cleanup);
+
+describe('homepage story', () => {
+    it('resets a selected scenario, bounds navigation and replays without accumulating events', () => {
+        let state = INITIAL_HOMEPAGE_STORY;
+        for (let index = 0; index < 20; index++) state = homepageStoryReducer(state, { type: 'next' });
+        expect(state.stepIndex).toBe(4);
+        state = homepageStoryReducer(state, { type: 'select', scenarioId: 'documents' });
+        expect(state).toEqual({ scenarioId: 'documents', stepIndex: 1 });
+        state = homepageStoryReducer(state, { type: 'replay' });
+        expect(homepageStoryReducer(state, { type: 'previous' })).toEqual({ scenarioId: 'documents', stepIndex: 0 });
+    });
+
+    it('keeps both languages structurally aligned, with human decisions, continuation and waiting', () => {
+        for (const [index, scenario] of HOMEPAGE_SCENARIOS.cs.entries()) {
+            const translated = HOMEPAGE_SCENARIOS.en[index];
+            expect(translated.id).toBe(scenario.id);
+            expect(translated.steps.map((step) => step.status)).toEqual(scenario.steps.map((step) => step.status));
+            expect(scenario.steps.map((step) => step.status)).toEqual(['incoming', 'prepared', 'decision', 'continuing', 'waiting']);
+            for (const version of [scenario, translated]) {
+                expect(version.ownerDecision.length).toBeGreaterThan(30);
+                expect(version.benefit.length).toBeGreaterThan(20);
+                expect(version.steps.every((step) => step.result && step.artifactDetail)).toBe(true);
+            }
+        }
+    });
+
+    it.each(['cs', 'en'] as const)('server renders an understandable result and disables unhydrated controls (%s)', (language) => {
+        const html = renderToStaticMarkup(<HomepageStory language={language} />);
+        expect(html).toContain(HOMEPAGE_SCENARIOS[language][0].benefit);
+        expect(html).toContain(HOMEPAGE_SCENARIOS[language][0].steps[1].description);
+        expect(html).toContain('aria-pressed="true"');
+        expect(html).toContain('disabled=""');
+        expect(html).toContain('href="#contact"');
+    });
+
+    it('rapid switches always agree across artifact, explanation and selection; visibility and enquiry do not advance', () => {
+        render(<HomepageStory language="en" />);
+        const content = HOMEPAGE_CONTENT.en;
+        for (const scenario of [...HOMEPAGE_SCENARIOS.en, ...HOMEPAGE_SCENARIOS.en].reverse()) {
+            fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: new RegExp(scenario.name.replace('&', '&')) }));
+            fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: content.story.next }));
+            expect(screen.getByTestId('homepage-story')).toHaveAttribute('data-scenario', scenario.id);
+            expect(screen.getByTestId('homepage-story')).toHaveAttribute('data-step', '2');
+            expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { name: scenario.steps[2].title })).toBeInTheDocument();
+            expect(screen.getByText(scenario.steps[2].artifactDetail)).toBeInTheDocument();
+            expect(screen.getByText(scenario.steps[2].result)).toBeInTheDocument();
+        }
+        const before = screen.getByTestId('homepage-story').textContent;
+        fireEvent(document, new Event('visibilitychange'));
+        fireEvent(window, new CustomEvent('open-qualification-popup'));
+        expect(screen.getByTestId('homepage-story').textContent).toBe(before);
+        expect(document.querySelectorAll('.ah-task')).toHaveLength(1);
+        expect(document.querySelectorAll('.ah-project')).toHaveLength(1);
+        fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: content.story.replay }));
+        expect(screen.getByTestId('homepage-story')).toHaveAttribute('data-step', '0');
+    });
+
+    it('contains a failed interactive render without losing readable summaries or conversion', () => {
+        const errorLog = vi.spyOn(console, 'error').mockImplementation(() => undefined);
+        const FailedStory = (): never => { throw new Error('Scene failed'); };
+        try {
+            render(<><HomepageStoryBoundary fallback="Read the examples below"><FailedStory /></HomepageStoryBoundary><p>{HOMEPAGE_SCENARIOS.en[0].benefit}</p><a href="#contact">Discuss our use case</a></>);
+            expect(screen.getByRole('status')).toHaveTextContent('Read the examples below');
+            expect(screen.getByText(HOMEPAGE_SCENARIOS.en[0].benefit)).toBeInTheDocument();
+            expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: 'Discuss our use case' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+        } finally { errorLog.mockRestore(); }
+    });
+});
diff --git a/businesses/homepage/homepageStoryModel.ts b/businesses/homepage/homepageStoryModel.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..526758859afb2d84a723b02abf605354c8bbdc8b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/businesses/homepage/homepageStoryModel.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+import { HOMEPAGE_SCENARIOS, type HomepageScenarioId } from './homepageScenarios';
+
+export type HomepageStoryState = { readonly scenarioId: HomepageScenarioId; readonly stepIndex: number };
+export type HomepageStoryAction =
+    | { readonly type: 'select'; readonly scenarioId: HomepageScenarioId }
+    | { readonly type: 'step'; readonly stepIndex: number }
+    | { readonly type: 'next' | 'previous' | 'replay' };
+
+// Start with a checked, still-unpublished result. Replay deliberately starts at the incoming need.
+export const INITIAL_HOMEPAGE_STORY: HomepageStoryState = { scenarioId: 'software', stepIndex: 1 };
+
+/** Pure finite story: no queue, timers, network effects or accumulated cards. */
+export function homepageStoryReducer(state: HomepageStoryState, action: HomepageStoryAction): HomepageStoryState {
+    if (action.type === 'select') return { scenarioId: action.scenarioId, stepIndex: INITIAL_HOMEPAGE_STORY.stepIndex };
+    const scenario = HOMEPAGE_SCENARIOS.cs.find((candidate) => candidate.id === state.scenarioId)!;
+    const requestedStep = action.type === 'step' ? action.stepIndex
+        : action.type === 'replay' ? 0
+        : state.stepIndex + (action.type === 'next' ? 1 : -1);
+    return { ...state, stepIndex: Math.max(0, Math.min(scenario.steps.length - 1, requestedStep)) };
+}

diff --git a/components/qualification-enquiry.tsx b/components/qualification-enquiry.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..cc3d5dd70a25954b42e8266fc920f26dbf21943f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/components/qualification-enquiry.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,116 @@
+'use client';
+
+import { PersonalDataConsentNote } from '@/components/legal/PersonalDataConsentNote';
+import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogTitle } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
+import { isEmailAddressValid } from '@/lib/isEmailAddressValid';
+import { subscribeToWaitlist } from '@/lib/subscription/subscribeToWaitlist';
+import type { SupportedHomepageLanguage } from '@/lib/homepage-language';
+import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
+
+export type QualificationEnquiryPresentation = {
+    readonly title: string;
+    readonly description: string;
+    readonly agendaLabel: string;
+    readonly agendaPlaceholder: string;
+    readonly agendaOptions: readonly string[];
+    readonly messageLabel: string;
+    readonly messagePlaceholder: string;
+    readonly fields: readonly { readonly id: 'name' | 'company' | 'email' | 'phone'; readonly label: string; readonly type: 'text' | 'email' | 'tel'; readonly autoComplete: string; readonly isRequired: boolean }[];
+    readonly requiredError: string;
+    readonly emailError: string;
+    readonly sendingError: string;
+    readonly submit: string;
+    readonly submitting: string;
+    readonly close: string;
+    readonly consentPurpose: string;
+    readonly successUrl: string;
+    readonly enquiryKind: string;
+};
+
+/** Configured presentation of the existing qualification lead, with the same source and consent infrastructure. */
+export function QualificationEnquiry({ language, presentation }: { readonly language: SupportedHomepageLanguage; readonly presentation: QualificationEnquiryPresentation }) {
+    const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
+    const [answers, setAnswers] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
+    const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
+    const [isValidationShown, setIsValidationShown] = useState(false);
+    const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
+    const isRequestPending = useRef(false);
+    const openerReference = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
+    const formReference = useRef<HTMLFormElement>(null);
+
+    useEffect(() => {
+        const open = () => {
+            if (document.activeElement instanceof HTMLElement) openerReference.current = document.activeElement;
+            setIsOpen(true);
+        };
+        window.addEventListener('open-qualification-popup', open);
+        return () => window.removeEventListener('open-qualification-popup', open);
+    }, []);
+
+    const fieldError = (field: string): string | undefined => {
+        const value = answers[field]?.trim();
+        const isRequired = field === 'agenda' || field === 'message' || presentation.fields.some((candidate) => candidate.id === field && candidate.isRequired);
+        if (isRequired && !value) return presentation.requiredError;
+        if (field === 'email' && value && !isEmailAddressValid(value)) return presentation.emailError;
+    };
+    const updateAnswer = (field: string, value: string) => setAnswers((previous) => ({ ...previous, [field]: value }));
+    const submit = async (event: FormEvent) => {
+        event.preventDefault();
+        if (isRequestPending.current) return;
+        setIsValidationShown(true);
+        if (['agenda', 'message', ...presentation.fields.map((field) => field.id)].some((field) => fieldError(field))) {
+            // After React displays errors, move to the first invalid input only on an explicit submit.
+            requestAnimationFrame(() => formReference.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[aria-invalid="true"]')?.focus());
+            return;
+        }
+        isRequestPending.current = true;
+        setIsSubmitting(true);
+        setError(null);
+        try {
+            await subscribeToWaitlist({
+                fullname: answers.name.trim(), email: answers.email.trim(), phone: answers.phone?.trim(),
+                placeName: 'qualification-popup',
+                note: JSON.stringify({ ...answers, enquiryKind: presentation.enquiryKind, language }, null, 4),
+            });
+            // Keep the established full-load conversion destination, without contact identity in its URL.
+            window.location.assign(presentation.successUrl);
+        } catch {
+            setError(presentation.sendingError);
+            isRequestPending.current = false;
+            setIsSubmitting(false);
+        }
+    };
+    const errorAttributes = (field: string) => ({
+        'aria-invalid': isValidationShown && !!fieldError(field),
+        'aria-describedby': isValidationShown && fieldError(field) ? `qualification-${field}-error` : undefined,
+    });
+    const renderError = (field: string) => isValidationShown && fieldError(field) ? <span className="ah-field-error" id={`qualification-${field}-error`}>{fieldError(field)}</span> : null;
+
+    return <Dialog open={isOpen} onOpenChange={setIsOpen}>
+        <DialogContent className="ah-enquiry" closeLabel={presentation.close} onCloseAutoFocus={(event) => { event.preventDefault(); openerReference.current?.focus(); }}>
+            <DialogTitle>{presentation.title}</DialogTitle>
+            <DialogDescription>{presentation.description}</DialogDescription>
+            <form ref={formReference} onSubmit={submit} noValidate>
+                <fieldset disabled={isSubmitting}>
+                    <label htmlFor="qualification-agenda">{presentation.agendaLabel}</label>
+                    <select id="qualification-agenda" value={answers.agenda ?? ''} onChange={(event) => updateAnswer('agenda', event.target.value)} required {...errorAttributes('agenda')}>
+                        <option value="">{presentation.agendaPlaceholder}</option>
+                        {presentation.agendaOptions.map((option) => <option key={option}>{option}</option>)}
+                    </select>
+                    {renderError('agenda')}
+                    <label htmlFor="qualification-message">{presentation.messageLabel}</label>
+                    <textarea id="qualification-message" value={answers.message ?? ''} onChange={(event) => updateAnswer('message', event.target.value)} placeholder={presentation.messagePlaceholder} rows={3} maxLength={4000} required {...errorAttributes('message')} />
+                    {renderError('message')}
+                    <div className="ah-enquiry-fields">{presentation.fields.map((field) => <div key={field.id}>
+                        <label htmlFor={`qualification-${field.id}`}>{field.label}</label>
+                        <input id={`qualification-${field.id}`} type={field.type} autoComplete={field.autoComplete} value={answers[field.id] ?? ''} onChange={(event) => updateAnswer(field.id, event.target.value)} required={field.isRequired} maxLength={320} {...errorAttributes(field.id)} />
+                        {renderError(field.id)}
+                    </div>)}</div>
+                </fieldset>
+                {error && <p role="alert" className="ah-field-error">{error}</p>}
+                <button className="ah-button" type="submit" disabled={isSubmitting}>{isSubmitting ? presentation.submitting : presentation.submit}</button>
+                <PersonalDataConsentNote language={language}>{presentation.consentPurpose}</PersonalDataConsentNote>
+            </form>
+        </DialogContent>
+    </Dialog>;
+}

index fc395d751dbc4ca59673fcd5f2bd5fd6d494b660..4437524155f364c1d44acdb16a9d5c0cc589b1bf

diff --git a/tests/e2e/homepage.spec.ts b/tests/e2e/homepage.spec.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..ce1add86f3ad705c35559e50e6d9a79cbc0ee0a2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/e2e/homepage.spec.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,194 @@
+import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test';
+import { HOMEPAGE_CONTENT } from '../../businesses/homepage/homepageContent';
+import { HOMEPAGE_SCENARIOS } from '../../businesses/homepage/homepageScenarios';
+import { getHomepageEnquiry, getHomepageEnquiryThanks } from '../../businesses/homepage/homepageEnquiry';
+import { createE2eTestEmail } from '../../lib/e2e/testData';
+import { submitAndExpectApiSuccess } from './support/submissions';
+
+test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
+    await page.addInitScript(() => {
+        localStorage.setItem('cookiesAccepted', 'true');
+        localStorage.setItem('cookiePreferences', JSON.stringify({ necessary: true, analytics: false, marketing: false }));
+    });
+});
+
+for (const language of ['cs', 'en'] as const) {
+    const CONTENT = HOMEPAGE_CONTENT[language];
+    const SCENARIOS = HOMEPAGE_SCENARIOS[language];
+    const ENQUIRY = getHomepageEnquiry(language);
+
+    test(`keeps selection, all story states, rapid switching and replay coherent without business requests (${language})`, async ({ page }) => {
+        const errors: string[] = [];
+        const businessRequests: string[] = [];
+        page.on('pageerror', (error) => errors.push(error.message));
+        page.on('request', (request) => {
+            if (new URL(request.url()).pathname.startsWith('/api/') || /openai|dashscope|anthropic/.test(request.url())) businessRequests.push(request.url());
+        });
+        await page.goto(`/${language}`);
+        await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1 })).toHaveText(CONTENT.title.join(''));
+        const story = page.getByTestId('homepage-story');
+        const picker = page.getByRole('group', { name: CONTENT.story.choose });
+        await expect(story).toHaveAttribute('data-step', '1');
+        for (const scenario of SCENARIOS) {
+            const selection = picker.getByRole('button', { name: new RegExp(scenario.name) });
+            await selection.click();
+            await expect(selection).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
+            await expect(story).toHaveAttribute('data-step', '1');
+            await story.getByRole('button', { name: CONTENT.story.replay }).click();
+            for (const [index, step] of scenario.steps.entries()) {
+                await expect(story).toHaveAttribute('data-step', String(index));
+                await expect(story.getByRole('heading', { name: step.title, exact: true })).toBeVisible();
+                await expect(story.locator('.ah-project')).toContainText(step.artifactDetail);
+                await expect(story.locator('.ah-step-result')).toContainText(step.result);
+                if (index < scenario.steps.length - 1) await story.getByRole('button', { name: CONTENT.story.next, exact: true }).click();
+            }
+            await expect(story.getByRole('button', { name: CONTENT.story.next, exact: true })).toBeDisabled();
+            await story.getByRole('button', { name: CONTENT.story.previous }).click();
+            await expect(story).toHaveAttribute('data-step', '3');
+        }
+        // Dispatch in the same browser turn, without waiting for any animation or a network round trip.
+        await picker.locator('button').evaluateAll((buttons) => { for (let index = 0; index < 24; index++) (buttons[index % buttons.length] as HTMLButtonElement).click(); (buttons[0] as HTMLButtonElement).click(); });
+        await expect(story).toHaveAttribute('data-scenario', 'software');
+        await expect(story).toHaveAttribute('data-step', '1');
+        await expect(story.locator('.ah-project')).toHaveCount(1);
+        await expect(story.locator('.ah-task')).toHaveCount(1);
+        await expect(story.getByRole('heading', { name: SCENARIOS[0].steps[1].title, exact: true })).toBeVisible();
+        expect(businessRequests).toEqual([]);
+        expect(errors).toEqual([]);
+    });
+
+    test(`enquiry validates, preserves drafts on close/failure, fences pending requests and succeeds (${language})`, async ({ page }) => {
+        let attempts = 0;
+        let releaseResponse!: () => void;
+        const pendingResponse = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { releaseResponse = resolve; });
+        const submissions: Record<string, string>[] = [];
+        await page.route('**/api/waitlist', async (route) => {
+            attempts++;
+            submissions.push(route.request().postDataJSON());
+            if (attempts === 1) { await pendingResponse; await route.fulfill({ status: 503, json: { error: 'Unavailable' } }); }
+            else await route.fulfill({ json: { success: true } });
+        });
+        await page.goto(`/${language}`);
+        await page.locator('#hero-cta').click();
+        const dialog = page.getByRole('dialog');
+        await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: ENQUIRY.submit, exact: true }).click();
+        await expect(dialog.getByText(ENQUIRY.requiredError).first()).toBeVisible();
+        expect(attempts).toBe(0);
+        await dialog.getByLabel(ENQUIRY.agendaLabel).selectOption(SCENARIOS[1].name);
+        await dialog.getByLabel(ENQUIRY.messageLabel).fill('Repeated work needs consistent follow-through.');
+        for (const field of ENQUIRY.fields) {
+            if (field.id !== 'phone') await dialog.getByLabel(field.label, { exact: true }).fill(field.id === 'email' ? 'invalid' : `Example ${field.id}`);
+        }
+        await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: ENQUIRY.submit, exact: true }).click();
+        await expect(dialog.getByText(ENQUIRY.emailError)).toBeVisible();
+        const emailLabel = ENQUIRY.fields.find((field) => field.id === 'email')!.label;
+        await dialog.getByLabel(emailLabel, { exact: true }).fill('homepage@example.com');
+        await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
+        await expect(dialog).not.toBeVisible();
+        await expect(page.locator('#hero-cta')).toBeFocused();
+        const story = page.getByTestId('homepage-story');
+        await expect(story).toHaveAttribute('data-step', '1');
+        await page.getByRole('group', { name: CONTENT.story.choose }).getByRole('button', { name: new RegExp(SCENARIOS[2].name) }).click();
+        await story.getByRole('link', { name: CONTENT.cta }).click();
+        await expect(dialog.getByLabel(ENQUIRY.messageLabel)).toHaveValue('Repeated work needs consistent follow-through.');
+        await expect(dialog.getByLabel(ENQUIRY.agendaLabel)).toHaveValue(SCENARIOS[1].name);
+        await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: ENQUIRY.submit, exact: true }).click();
+        await expect(dialog.getByRole('button', { name: ENQUIRY.submitting, exact: true })).toBeDisabled();
+        await expect(dialog.getByLabel(emailLabel, { exact: true })).toBeDisabled();
+        await dialog.locator('form').evaluate((form) => { form.dispatchEvent(new Event('submit', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); });
+        releaseResponse();
+        await expect(dialog.getByRole('alert')).toHaveText(ENQUIRY.sendingError);
+        expect(attempts).toBe(1);
+        await expect(dialog.getByLabel(emailLabel, { exact: true })).toHaveValue('homepage@example.com');
+        await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: ENQUIRY.submit, exact: true }).click();
+        await expect(page).toHaveURL(new RegExp(`/dekujeme\\?source=autonomous-agendas&lang=${language}`));
+        await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1 })).toHaveText(getHomepageEnquiryThanks(language).successTitle);
+        expect(attempts).toBe(2);
+        expect(submissions[1]).toMatchObject({ placeName: 'qualification-popup', email: 'homepage@example.com' });
+        expect(submissions[1].userNote).toContain('autonomous-agenda');
+        expect(page.url()).not.toContain('homepage@example');
+    });
+
+    test(`phone, keyboard, reduced motion, real anchors and depth links (${language})`, async ({ page }) => {
+        await page.setViewportSize({ width: 375, height: 812 });
+        await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'reduce', colorScheme: 'dark' });
+        await page.goto(`/${language}`);
+        const selected = page.getByRole('group', { name: CONTENT.story.choose }).getByRole('button', { name: new RegExp(SCENARIOS[1].name) });
+        await selected.focus(); await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
+        await expect(selected).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
+        await expect(selected).toBeFocused();
+        const transform = await page.locator('.ah-scene-stack').evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).transform);
+        await page.locator('#control').scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+        expect(await page.locator('.ah-scene-stack').evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).transform)).toBe(transform);
+        expect(await page.locator('.ah-page').evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).backgroundColor)).toBe('rgb(255, 255, 255)');
+        await page.getByLabel(CONTENT.menu, { exact: true }).click();
+        await page.locator('.ah-mobile-navigation').getByRole('link', { name: CONTENT.examples }).click();
+        await expect(page.locator('.ah-mobile-navigation')).not.toHaveAttribute('open', '');
+        expect(await page.evaluate(() => [...document.querySelectorAll('.ah-page a[href^="#"]')].every((link) => document.getElementById(link.getAttribute('href')!.slice(1))))).toBe(true);
+        await expect(page.getByRole('link', { name: CONTENT.depth.paper, exact: true })).toHaveAttribute('href', `https://ptbk.io/${language}/whitepaper`);
+        await expect(page.getByRole('link', { name: CONTENT.depth.companyLink, exact: true }).first()).toHaveAttribute('href', 'https://ptbk.io/cs/pro-firmy');
+        for (const width of [320, 375, 768]) {
+            await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 812 });
+            expect(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth)).toBe(true);
+        }
+        await page.getByRole('link', { name: language === 'cs' ? 'English' : 'Česky', exact: true }).click();
+        await expect(page).toHaveURL(language === 'cs' ? /\/en$/ : /\/cs$/);
+    });
+
+    test(`readable scenarios, boundaries and conversion without JavaScript (${language})`, async ({ browser, baseURL }) => {
+        const context = await browser.newContext({ javaScriptEnabled: false, baseURL, viewport: { width: 375, height: 812 } });
+        const page = await context.newPage();
+        await page.goto(`/${language}`, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
+        await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1 })).toHaveText(CONTENT.title.join(''));
+        await page.locator('#agenda-summaries summary').click();
+        for (const scenario of SCENARIOS) await expect(page.locator('#agenda-summaries').getByText(scenario.ownerDecision, { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
+        await expect(page.locator('.ah-scenario-picker button').first()).toBeDisabled();
+        await page.locator('#hero-cta').click();
+        await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: CONTENT.closing.title })).toBeInViewport();
+        await expect(page.getByRole('link', { name: CONTENT.closing.contactLink })).toHaveAttribute('href', '/contact');
+        expect(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth)).toBe(true);
+        await context.close();
+    });
+}
+
+test('the real qualification API accepts the homepage enquiry and preserves attribution', async ({ page }) => {
+    const content = getHomepageEnquiry('en');
+    await page.goto('/en');
+    await page.locator('#hero-cta').click();
+    const dialog = page.getByRole('dialog');
+    await dialog.getByLabel(content.agendaLabel).selectOption('Websites & applications');
+    await dialog.getByLabel(content.messageLabel).fill('E2E fictional maintenance enquiry.');
+    await dialog.getByLabel('Name *', { exact: true }).fill('E2E Homepage');
+    await dialog.getByLabel('Company *', { exact: true }).fill('E2E Example');
+    await dialog.getByLabel('Email *', { exact: true }).fill(createE2eTestEmail('homepage'));
+    const request = page.waitForRequest((candidate) => candidate.url().endsWith('/api/waitlist') && candidate.method() === 'POST');
+    await submitAndExpectApiSuccess(page, '/api/waitlist', () => dialog.getByRole('button', { name: content.submit, exact: true }).click());
+    expect((await request).postDataJSON()).toMatchObject({ placeName: 'qualification-popup' });
+    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/dekujeme\?source=autonomous-agendas&lang=en/);
+});
+
+test('background and offscreen return preserve a chosen story without catch-up', async ({ page, context }) => {
+    await page.goto('/en');
+    const story = page.getByTestId('homepage-story');
+    await story.getByRole('button', { name: 'Next step', exact: true }).click();
+    await expect(story).toHaveAttribute('data-step', '2');
+    await page.locator('#contact').scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+    const otherPage = await context.newPage();
+    await otherPage.goto('about:blank');
+    await otherPage.bringToFront();
+    await page.bringToFront();
+    await story.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+    await expect(story).toHaveAttribute('data-step', '2');
+    await expect(story.locator('.ah-step-detail')).toContainText('Going live has its own rules.');
+    await otherPage.close();
+});
+
+test('failed client scripts leave the complete static offer and native navigation usable', async ({ page }) => {
+    await page.route(/\/_next\/static\/.*\.js(?:\?|$)/, (route) => route.abort());
+    await page.goto('/en', { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
+    await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1 })).toContainText('Hand over the routine.');
+    await page.locator('#agenda-summaries summary').click();
+    await expect(page.locator('#agenda-summaries').getByText(HOMEPAGE_SCENARIOS.en[2].ownerDecision)).toBeVisible();
+    await page.locator('#hero-cta').click();
+    await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: HOMEPAGE_CONTENT.en.closing.title })).toBeInViewport();
+});

+const { chromium } = require('@playwright/test');
+const fs = require('node:fs/promises');
+(async () => {
+    const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });
+    const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 1000 }, reducedMotion: 'reduce' });
+    await page.route(/logrocket|google-analytics|googletagmanager/, route => route.abort());
+    const results = {};
+    for (const path of ['/cs/pro-firmy', '/cs/whitepaper', '/en/whitepaper']) {
+        await page.goto(`http://127.0.0.1:4010${path}`, { timeout: 180000 });
+        await page.locator('h1').waitFor();
+        await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
+        const key = path.replaceAll('/', '-');
+        await page.screenshot({ path: `.tmp/before${key}.png`, fullPage: true });
+        results[path] = await page.evaluate(() => ({
+            text: document.querySelector('main').textContent,
+            metadata: [...document.querySelectorAll('meta[property^="og:"], meta[name^="twitter:"], link[rel="canonical"], link[rel="alternate"]')].map(element => element.outerHTML),
+        }));
+    }
+    await fs.writeFile('.tmp/homepage-baseline.json', JSON.stringify(results, null, 2));
+    await browser.close();
+})();

diff --git a/.tmp/homepage-verify-render.cjs b/.tmp/homepage-verify-render.cjs

@@ -0,0 +1,32 @@
+const { chromium } = require('@playwright/test');
+const fs = require('node:fs/promises');
+(async () => {
+    const browser = await chromium.launch({headless:true});
+    const page = await browser.newPage({viewport:{width:1440,height:1000}, reducedMotion:'reduce'});
+    await page.route(/logrocket|google-analytics|googletagmanager|facebook/, route => route.abort());
+    const baseline = JSON.parse(await fs.readFile('.tmp/homepage-baseline.json','utf8'));
+    for (const path of Object.keys(baseline)) {
+        await page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:4010'+path,{timeout:180000});
+        await page.evaluate(()=>document.fonts.ready);
+        const current = await page.evaluate(()=>({text:document.querySelector('main').textContent,metadata:[...document.querySelectorAll('meta[property^="og:"],meta[name^="twitter:"],link[rel="canonical"],link[rel="alternate"]')].map(element=>element.outerHTML)}));
+        console.log(path, 'text identical',current.text===baseline[path].text,'metadata identical',JSON.stringify(current.metadata)===JSON.stringify(baseline[path].metadata));
+        await page.screenshot({path:'.tmp/after'+path.replaceAll('/','-')+'.png',fullPage:true});
+    }
+    await page.addInitScript(()=>{localStorage.setItem('cookiesAccepted','true');});
+    for(const language of ['cs','en']) {
+        await page.setViewportSize({width:1440,height:1000});
+        await page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:4010/'+language,{timeout:180000});
+        await page.evaluate(()=>document.fonts.ready);
+        await page.screenshot({path:'.tmp/'+language+'-hero.png'});
+        await page.locator('.ah-experience').screenshot({path:'.tmp/'+language+'-experience.png'});
+        await page.setViewportSize({width:375,height:812});
+        for(let index=0;index<3;index++) {
+            await page.locator('.ah-scenario-picker button').nth(index).click();
+            await page.locator('.ah-scene').screenshot({path:'.tmp/'+language+'-phone-scene-'+index+'.png'});
+        }
+        await page.locator('#hero-cta').click();
+        await page.getByRole('dialog').screenshot({path:'.tmp/'+language+'-phone-enquiry.png'});
+        await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
+    }
+    await browser.close();
+})();

diff --git a/businesses/homepage/HomepageArtifact.tsx b/businesses/homepage/HomepageArtifact.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..67164dec2720258f431fb127ab02072dca511f15
--- /dev/null
+++ b/businesses/homepage/HomepageArtifact.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,57 @@
+import { ArrowUpRight, Check, CircleHelp, FileText, MessageSquare, Pause, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react';
+import type { HomepageContent } from './homepageContent';
+import type { HomepageScenario, HomepageStoryStep, HomepageWorkStatus } from './homepageScenarios';
+
+const STATUS_ICONS = { incoming: CircleHelp, prepared: Check, decision: CircleHelp, continuing: ArrowUpRight, waiting: Pause };
+
+export function HomepageStatus({ status, children }: { readonly status: HomepageWorkStatus; readonly children: string }) {
+    const Icon = STATUS_ICONS[status];
+    return <span className="ah-status" data-status={status}><Icon size={14} aria-hidden="true" />{children}</span>;
+}
+
+/** DOM-based project, agent and task surfaces stay readable in the first server response. */
+export function HomepageArtifact({ scenario, step, content, isInteractive, onStep }: {
+    readonly scenario: HomepageScenario;
+    readonly step: HomepageStoryStep;
+    readonly content: HomepageContent['story'];
+    readonly isInteractive: boolean;
+    readonly onStep: (stepIndex: number) => void;
+}) {
+    return <div className="ah-scene" data-scenario={scenario.id} data-status={step.status}>
+        <div className="ah-scene-shadow" aria-hidden="true" />
+        <div className="ah-scene-stack">
+            <button type="button" className="ah-agent" disabled={!isInteractive} onClick={() => onStep(3)} aria-label={content.agentAction}>
+                <span className="ah-agent-orb"><Sparkles size={22} aria-hidden="true" /></span>
+                <span><small>Promptbook</small><strong>{scenario.role}</strong></span>
+                <ArrowUpRight size={15} aria-hidden="true" />
+            </button>
+            <button type="button" className="ah-project" onClick={() => onStep(1)} disabled={!isInteractive} aria-label={content.projectAction}>
+                <span className="ah-project-chrome"><span className="ah-window-dots" aria-hidden="true">•••</span>{scenario.project}<span className="ah-preview-label">{content.preview}</span></span>
+                <span className={`ah-project-content ah-project-${scenario.id}`}>
+                    {scenario.id === 'software' && <>
+                        <span className="ah-site-brand">studio<span>north</span><span className="ah-site-menu" aria-hidden="true">≡</span></span>
+                        <span className="ah-site-layout"><span><strong>{step.artifactTitle}</strong><span className="ah-site-lines" aria-hidden="true" /></span><span className="ah-site-sculpture" aria-hidden="true"><i /><i /><i /></span></span>
+                        <span className="ah-mini-form"><span>{content.formLabel}</span><span data-is-broken={step.status === 'incoming'}>{content.formButton}<ArrowUpRight size={12} aria-hidden="true" /></span></span>
+                        <span className="ah-artifact-detail">{step.artifactDetail}</span>
+                    </>}
+                    {scenario.id === 'communication' && <>
+                        <span className="ah-artifact-icon"><MessageSquare size={24} aria-hidden="true" /></span>
+                        <strong className="ah-artifact-title">{step.artifactTitle}</strong>
+                        <span className="ah-message">{step.artifactDetail}</span>
+                        <span className="ah-message-lines" aria-hidden="true"><i /><i /></span>
+                    </>}
+                    {scenario.id === 'documents' && <>
+                        <strong className="ah-artifact-title">{step.artifactTitle}</strong>
+                        <span className="ah-document-list">{content.documentLabels.map((label, index) => <span key={label}><FileText size={20} aria-hidden="true" /><span>{label}</span>{index === 2 ? <CircleHelp size={16} aria-hidden="true" /> : <Check size={16} aria-hidden="true" />}</span>)}</span>
+                        <span className="ah-artifact-detail">{step.artifactDetail}</span>
+                    </>}
+                </span>
+            </button>
+            <button type="button" className="ah-task" disabled={!isInteractive} onClick={() => onStep(2)} aria-label={content.taskAction}>
+                <HomepageStatus status={step.status}>{step.statusLabel}</HomepageStatus>
+                <strong>{step.task}</strong>
+                <span className="ah-task-line" aria-hidden="true"><i /><i /><i /></span>
+            </button>
+        </div>
+    </div>;
+}
diff --git a/businesses/homepage/HomepageEnquiryLink.tsx b/businesses/homepage/HomepageEnquiryLink.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..941cd94a0f5f1372da4bcff6a22e7c957b62a7f4
--- /dev/null
+++ b/businesses/homepage/HomepageEnquiryLink.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,16 @@
+'use client';
+
+import { ArrowUpRight } from 'lucide-react';
+import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
+
+/** A real contact anchor before hydration, the same persistent enquiry everywhere after it. */
+export function HomepageEnquiryLink({ children, id, className = 'ah-button' }: {
+    readonly children: ReactNode;
+    readonly id?: string;
+    readonly className?: string;
+}) {
+    return <a id={id} className={className} href="#contact" onClick={(event) => {
+        event.preventDefault();
+        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('open-qualification-popup'));
+    }}>{children}<ArrowUpRight size={17} aria-hidden="true" /></a>;
+}

+import { MinimalFooter } from '@/components/minimal-footer';
+import type { SupportedHomepageLanguage } from '@/lib/homepage-language';
+import { getHomepageEnquiryThanks } from './homepageEnquiry';
+import { CheckCircle2 } from 'lucide-react';
+import Link from 'next/link';
+
+export function HomepageEnquiryThanks({ language }: { readonly language: SupportedHomepageLanguage }) {
+    const content = getHomepageEnquiryThanks(language);
+    return <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col bg-white text-slate-900" lang={language}>
+        <main className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center px-6 py-24 text-center">
+            <CheckCircle2 size={48} className="text-teal-700 mb-8" aria-hidden="true" />
+            <h1 className="max-w-2xl text-4xl sm:text-5xl mb-6">{content.successTitle}</h1>
+            <p className="max-w-lg text-lg text-slate-600 leading-relaxed">{content.successDescription}</p>
+            <Link className="mt-10 underline underline-offset-4 text-teal-800" href={`/${language}`}>{content.back}</Link>
+        </main>
+        <MinimalFooter language={language} />
+    </div>;
+}
diff --git a/businesses/homepage/HomepageMobileNavigation.tsx b/businesses/homepage/HomepageMobileNavigation.tsx

@@ -0,0 +1,10 @@
+'use client';
+
+import { useRef, type ReactNode } from 'react';
+
+export function HomepageMobileNavigation({ label, children }: { readonly label: string; readonly children: ReactNode }) {
+    const reference = useRef<HTMLDetailsElement>(null);
+    return <details ref={reference} className="ah-mobile-navigation" onClick={(event) => {
+        if (event.target instanceof Element && event.target.closest('a')) reference.current?.removeAttribute('open');
+    }}><summary aria-label={label}><span /><span /></summary>{children}</details>;
+}
diff --git a/businesses/homepage/HomepagePage.tsx b/businesses/homepage/HomepagePage.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..a008995f5572794b07855fc2fb007ba334728cbf
--- /dev/null
+++ b/businesses/homepage/HomepagePage.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,97 @@
+import Image from 'next/image';
+import Link from 'next/link';
+import { ArrowRight, ArrowUpRight, Compass, SlidersHorizontal, Eye } from 'lucide-react';
+import { Footer } from '@/components/footer';
+import { QualificationPopup } from '@/components/qualification-popup';
+import { createPublicUrl } from '@/lib/domains/publicDomainRouting';
+import type { SupportedHomepageLanguage } from '@/lib/homepage-language';
+import { PRO_FIRMY_PATH } from '@/businesses/pro-firmy/config';
+import { WHITEPAPER_PATHS } from '@/businesses/whitepaper/whitepaperConfig';
+import { HOMEPAGE_CONTENT } from './homepageContent';
+import { HOMEPAGE_SCENARIOS } from './homepageScenarios';
+import { getHomepageEnquiry } from './homepageEnquiry';
+import { HomepageEnquiryLink } from './HomepageEnquiryLink';
+import HomepageStory from './HomepageStory';
+import { HomepageStoryBoundary } from './HomepageStoryBoundary';
+import { HomepageMobileNavigation } from './HomepageMobileNavigation';
+import './homepage.css';
+
+const OWNERSHIP_ICONS = [Compass, SlidersHorizontal, Eye];
+
+/** The business homepage owns its words and sections; the company-data offer remains independent. */
+export function HomepagePage({ language }: { readonly language: SupportedHomepageLanguage }) {
+    const content = HOMEPAGE_CONTENT[language];
+    const whitepaperUrl = createPublicUrl(WHITEPAPER_PATHS[language]);
+    const companyUrl = createPublicUrl(PRO_FIRMY_PATH);
+    const navigation = [
+        { href: '#agendas', label: content.examples },
+        { href: '#control', label: content.control },
+        { href: whitepaperUrl, label: 'Whitepaper' },
+    ];
+    const navigationLinks = navigation.map((item) => <a key={item.href} href={item.href}>{item.label}</a>);
+
+    return <div className="ah-page" lang={language}>
+        <a className="ah-skip" href="#homepage-main">{content.skip}</a>
+        <header className="ah-header">
+            <div className="ah-header-inner">
+                <Link href={`/${language}`} className="ah-brand" aria-label="Promptbook">
+                    <Image src="/logo/promptbook-logo-blue-transparent-128.png" width={30} height={30} alt="" />Promptbook
+                </Link>
+                <nav className="ah-desktop-navigation" aria-label={content.navigation}>{navigationLinks}</nav>
+                <div className="ah-header-actions">
+                    <nav className="ah-language" aria-label={language === 'cs' ? 'Jazyk' : 'Language'}>
+                        {(['cs', 'en'] as const).map((candidate) => <Link key={candidate} href={`/${candidate}`} hrefLang={candidate} lang={candidate} aria-label={candidate === 'cs' ? 'Česky' : 'English'} aria-current={candidate === language ? 'page' : undefined}>{candidate === 'cs' ? 'CZ' : 'EN'}</Link>)}
+                    </nav>
+                    <HomepageEnquiryLink className="ah-button ah-header-cta">{content.cta}</HomepageEnquiryLink>
+                    <HomepageMobileNavigation label={content.menu}><nav aria-label={content.navigation}>{navigationLinks}<a href="#contact">{content.contact}</a></nav></HomepageMobileNavigation>
+                </div>
+            </div>
+        </header>
+        <main id="homepage-main">
+            <section className="ah-hero ah-container" aria-labelledby="homepage-title">
+                <p className="ah-eyebrow"><span />{content.eyebrow}</p>
+                <h1 id="homepage-title"><span>{content.title[0]}</span><span>{content.title[1]}</span></h1>
+                <p className="ah-hero-description">{content.description}</p>
+                <div className="ah-hero-actions"><HomepageEnquiryLink id="hero-cta">{content.cta}</HomepageEnquiryLink><a className="ah-text-link" href="#agendas">{content.explore}<ArrowRight size={17} aria-hidden="true" /></a></div>
+                <p className="ah-hero-note">{content.heroNote}</p>
+            </section>
+            <section className="ah-agendas ah-container" id="agendas" aria-labelledby="agendas-title">
+                <div className="ah-section-heading"><p className="ah-eyebrow">{content.story.eyebrow}</p><h2 id="agendas-title">{content.story.title}</h2></div>
+                <HomepageStoryBoundary fallback={content.story.fallback}><HomepageStory language={language} /></HomepageStoryBoundary>
+                <p className="ah-vision-note">{content.story.note}</p>
+                <details className="ah-summaries" id="agenda-summaries">
+                    <summary>{content.story.summaries}<span aria-hidden="true">+</span></summary>
+                    <div>{HOMEPAGE_SCENARIOS[language].map((scenario) => <article key={scenario.id}>
+                        <h3>{scenario.name}</h3><p className="ah-summary-benefit">{scenario.benefit}</p>
+                        <dl>{[[content.story.burden, scenario.burden], [content.story.entrusted, scenario.entrusted], [content.story.owner, scenario.ownerDecision]].map(([label, value]) => <div key={label}><dt>{label}</dt><dd>{value}</dd></div>)}</dl>
+                    </article>)}</div>
+                </details>
+            </section>
+            <section className="ah-comparison ah-container" aria-labelledby="comparison-title">
+                <h2 id="comparison-title">{content.comparison.title}</h2>
+                {[content.comparison.beforeSteps, content.comparison.afterSteps].map((steps, index) => <div className="ah-comparison-row" data-is-agenda={index === 1} key={index}>
+                    <h3>{index === 0 ? content.comparison.before : content.comparison.after}</h3>
+                    <ol>{steps.map((step, stepIndex) => <li key={step}><span>{step}</span>{stepIndex < steps.length - 1 && <ArrowRight size={17} aria-hidden="true" />}</li>)}</ol>
+                </div>)}
+            </section>
+            <section className="ah-control" id="control" aria-labelledby="control-title"><div className="ah-container">
+                <div className="ah-section-heading"><p className="ah-eyebrow">{content.ownership.eyebrow}</p><h2 id="control-title">{content.ownership.title}</h2></div>
+                <div className="ah-control-cards">{content.ownership.cards.map((card, index) => {
+                    const Icon = OWNERSHIP_ICONS[index];
+                    return <article key={card.title}><Icon size={27} strokeWidth={1.4} aria-hidden="true" /><span className="ah-card-number">0{index + 1}</span><h3>{card.title}</h3><p>{card.description}</p></article>;
+                })}</div>
+            </div></section>
+            <section className="ah-closing ah-container" id="contact" aria-labelledby="contact-title">
+                <p className="ah-eyebrow">{content.closing.eyebrow}</p><h2 id="contact-title">{content.closing.title}</h2><p>{content.closing.description}</p>
+                <div className="ah-hero-actions"><HomepageEnquiryLink>{content.cta}</HomepageEnquiryLink><Link className="ah-text-link" href="/contact">{content.closing.contactLink}<ArrowUpRight size={16} aria-hidden="true" /></Link></div>
+                <div className="ah-people"><div><Image src="/people/jiri-jahn-transparent-square.png" alt="Jiří Jahn" width={48} height={48} /><Image src="/people/pavol-hejny-transparent-square.png" alt="Pavol Hejný" width={48} height={48} /></div><span>{content.closing.people}</span></div>
+            </section>
+            <aside className="ah-depth ah-container"><div><h2>{content.depth.title}</h2><p>{content.depth.description}</p><a className="ah-text-link" href={whitepaperUrl}>{content.depth.paper}<ArrowUpRight size={16} aria-hidden="true" /></a></div><div><h2>{content.depth.company}</h2><a className="ah-text-link" href={companyUrl}>{content.depth.companyLink}<ArrowUpRight size={16} aria-hidden="true" /></a></div></aside>
+        </main>
+        <Footer language={language} claim={content.footerClaim} isTechnologyIncubationShown productLinks={[
+            { href: '#agendas', text: content.examples }, { href: '#control', text: content.control },
+            { href: '#contact', text: content.contact }, { href: whitepaperUrl, text: 'Whitepaper' }, { href: companyUrl, text: content.depth.companyLink },
+        ]} />
+        <QualificationPopup language={language} presentation={getHomepageEnquiry(language)} />
+    </div>;
+}
diff --git a/businesses/homepage/HomepageSceneMotion.tsx b/businesses/homepage/HomepageSceneMotion.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..daa7ea3c097913122b9115e6550a1c1c3911ca31
--- /dev/null
+++ b/businesses/homepage/HomepageSceneMotion.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+'use client';
+
+import { useMotionValueEvent, useScroll } from 'framer-motion';
+import { useEffect, type RefObject } from 'react';
+
+/** Optional presentation only. Scroll never chooses a story step or changes its meaning. */
+export default function HomepageSceneMotion({ sceneReference }: { readonly sceneReference: RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null> }) {
+    const { scrollYProgress } = useScroll({ target: sceneReference, offset: ['start end', 'end start'] });
+    const applyDepth = (progress: number) => {
+        sceneReference.current?.style.setProperty('--ah-tilt', `${12 - progress * 12}deg`);
+        sceneReference.current?.style.setProperty('--ah-lift', `${progress * -24}px`);
+    };
+    useMotionValueEvent(scrollYProgress, 'change', applyDepth);
+    useEffect(() => {
+        applyDepth(scrollYProgress.get());
+        // The controller is unmounted offscreen, in hidden tabs and for reduced motion.
+        // Preserve the last still frame; do not run catch-up animations on return.
+    });
+    return null;
+}
diff --git a/businesses/homepage/HomepageStory.tsx b/businesses/homepage/HomepageStory.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..8f789381756d4807b71e671107c8da40d36e9d68
--- /dev/null
+++ b/businesses/homepage/HomepageStory.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,71 @@
+'use client';
+
+import dynamic from 'next/dynamic';
+import { ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';
+import { useInView, useReducedMotion } from 'framer-motion';
+import { useEffect, useReducer, useRef, useState } from 'react';
+import type { SupportedHomepageLanguage } from '@/lib/homepage-language';
+import { HOMEPAGE_CONTENT } from './homepageContent';
+import { HOMEPAGE_SCENARIOS } from './homepageScenarios';
+import { homepageStoryReducer, INITIAL_HOMEPAGE_STORY } from './homepageStoryModel';
+import { HomepageArtifact, HomepageStatus } from './HomepageArtifact';
+import { HomepageEnquiryLink } from './HomepageEnquiryLink';
+
+const HomepageSceneMotion = dynamic(() => import('./HomepageSceneMotion'), { ssr: false });
+
+export default function HomepageStory({ language }: { readonly language: SupportedHomepageLanguage }) {
+    const content = HOMEPAGE_CONTENT[language];
+    const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(homepageStoryReducer, INITIAL_HOMEPAGE_STORY);
+    const [isInteractive, setIsInteractive] = useState(false);
+    const [isDocumentVisible, setIsDocumentVisible] = useState(false);
+    const sceneReference = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
+    const isInView = useInView(sceneReference);
+    const isReducedMotion = useReducedMotion();
+    useEffect(() => {
+        setIsInteractive(true);
+        const updateVisibility = () => setIsDocumentVisible(document.visibilityState === 'visible');
+        updateVisibility();
+        document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', updateVisibility);
+        return () => document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', updateVisibility);
+    }, []);
+
+    const scenario = HOMEPAGE_SCENARIOS[language].find((candidate) => candidate.id === state.scenarioId)!;
+    const step = scenario.steps[state.stepIndex];
+    const selectStep = (stepIndex: number) => dispatch({ type: 'step', stepIndex });
+
+    return <div className="ah-experience" data-testid="homepage-story" data-scenario={scenario.id} data-step={state.stepIndex}>
+        <div className="ah-scenario-picker" role="group" aria-label={content.story.choose}>
+            {HOMEPAGE_SCENARIOS[language].map((candidate, index) => <button key={candidate.id} type="button" aria-pressed={candidate.id === scenario.id} aria-controls="homepage-story-panel" disabled={!isInteractive} onClick={() => dispatch({ type: 'select', scenarioId: candidate.id })}>
+                <span aria-hidden="true">0{index + 1}</span>{candidate.name}
+            </button>)}
+        </div>
+        <div id="homepage-story-panel" className="ah-story-panel" ref={sceneReference}>
+            <div className="ah-story-copy">
+                <p className="ah-eyebrow">{content.story.scope}</p>
+                <h3>{scenario.benefit}</h3>
+                <p>{scenario.entrusted}</p>
+                <HomepageEnquiryLink className="ah-text-link">{content.cta}</HomepageEnquiryLink>
+            </div>
+            <HomepageArtifact scenario={scenario} step={step} content={content.story} isInteractive={isInteractive} onStep={selectStep} />
+            {isInteractive && isInView && isDocumentVisible && !isReducedMotion && <HomepageSceneMotion sceneReference={sceneReference} />}
+        </div>
+        <div className="ah-story-bottom">
+            <div className="ah-story-steps" role="group" aria-label={content.story.steps}>
+                {scenario.steps.map((candidate, index) => <button key={index} type="button" disabled={!isInteractive} aria-pressed={index === state.stepIndex} aria-controls="homepage-step-detail" onClick={() => selectStep(index)}><span>{index + 1}</span>{candidate.label}</button>)}
+            </div>
+            <div id="homepage-step-detail" className="ah-step-detail" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true">
+                <div><HomepageStatus status={step.status}>{step.statusLabel}</HomepageStatus><h4>{step.title}</h4><p>{step.description}</p></div>
+                <div className="ah-step-result"><span>{content.story.result}</span><strong>{step.result}</strong></div>
+            </div>
+            <div className="ah-story-toolbar">
+                <span className="ah-demo-label">{content.story.demo}</span>
+                <div className="ah-story-actions">
+                    <button type="button" disabled={!isInteractive} onClick={() => dispatch({ type: 'replay' })} aria-label={content.story.replay} title={content.story.replay}><RotateCcw size={17} aria-hidden="true" /></button>
+                    <button type="button" disabled={!isInteractive || state.stepIndex === 0} onClick={() => dispatch({ type: 'previous' })} aria-label={content.story.previous}><ArrowLeft size={18} aria-hidden="true" /></button>
+                    <span className="ah-step-count" aria-hidden="true">{state.stepIndex + 1} / {scenario.steps.length}</span>
+                    <button type="button" disabled={!isInteractive || state.stepIndex === scenario.steps.length - 1} onClick={() => dispatch({ type: 'next' })} aria-label={content.story.next}><ArrowRight size={18} aria-hidden="true" /></button>
+                </div>
+            </div>
+        </div>
+    </div>;
+}
diff --git a/businesses/homepage/HomepageStoryBoundary.tsx b/businesses/homepage/HomepageStoryBoundary.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..f576f9d9b2c98df18423c167883cf8893f74cb39
--- /dev/null
+++ b/businesses/homepage/HomepageStoryBoundary.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+'use client';
+
+import { Component, type ReactNode } from 'react';
+
+/** The server-rendered summaries and enquiry are outside this optional interactive island. */
+export class HomepageStoryBoundary extends Component<{ readonly children: ReactNode; readonly fallback: string }, { readonly isFailed: boolean }> {
+    state = { isFailed: false };
+    static getDerivedStateFromError() { return { isFailed: true }; }
+    render() {
+        return this.state.isFailed ? <p className="ah-story-fallback" role="status"><a href="#agenda-summaries">{this.props.fallback}</a></p> : this.props.children;
+    }
+}

new file mode 100644

+/* Isolated light presentation. No shared company or whitepaper selectors. */

+@media (max-width: 360px) {

+import type { QualificationEnquiryPresentation } from '@/components/qualification-enquiry';
+import type { SupportedHomepageLanguage } from '@/lib/homepage-language';
+import { HOMEPAGE_SCENARIOS } from './homepageScenarios';
+
+export function getHomepageEnquiry(language: SupportedHomepageLanguage): QualificationEnquiryPresentation {
+    const content = HOMEPAGE_ENQUIRY_CONTENT[language];
+    return {
+        ...content,
+        enquiryKind: 'autonomous-agenda',
+        agendaOptions: [...HOMEPAGE_SCENARIOS[language].map((scenario) => scenario.name), content.otherAgenda],
+        successUrl: `/dekujeme?source=autonomous-agendas&lang=${language}`,
+        fields: [
+            { id: 'name', label: content.name, type: 'text', autoComplete: 'name', isRequired: true },
+            { id: 'company', label: content.company, type: 'text', autoComplete: 'organization', isRequired: true },
+            { id: 'email', label: content.email, type: 'email', autoComplete: 'email', isRequired: true },
+            { id: 'phone', label: content.phone, type: 'tel', autoComplete: 'tel', isRequired: false },
+        ],
+    };
+}
+
+const HOMEPAGE_ENQUIRY_CONTENT = {

@@ -0,0 +1,25 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import { HOMEPAGE_METADATA, HOMEPAGE_PAGE_DEFINITIONS, HOMEPAGE_SOCIAL_PREVIEW_OPTIONS } from './homepageMetadata';
+import { PRO_FIRMY_METADATA } from '@/businesses/pro-firmy/proFirmyMetadata';
+import { resolveSocialPreviewImagePath } from '@/lib/metadata/social-preview-image-path';
+import { INDEXED_PAGE_METADATA_DEFINITIONS } from '@/lib/metadata/page-registry';
+
+describe('autonomous responsibility homepage metadata', () => {
+    it.each(['cs', 'en'] as const)('owns localized positioning and a new card while preserving routes (%s)', (language) => {
+        const definition = HOMEPAGE_PAGE_DEFINITIONS[language];
+        const metadata = HOMEPAGE_METADATA[language];
+        expect(metadata.alternates?.canonical).toBe(`https://ptbk.io/${language}`);
+        expect(metadata.alternates?.languages).toMatchObject({ cs: 'https://ptbk.io/cs', en: 'https://ptbk.io/en' });
+        expect(INDEXED_PAGE_METADATA_DEFINITIONS).toContain(definition);
+        expect(metadata.openGraph?.images).toEqual(metadata.twitter?.images);
+        expect(JSON.stringify(metadata)).not.toMatch(/halucin|hallucinat|100%|virtual employee|virtuální zaměstnanec|Instant access|Okamžitý přístup/);
+        expect(HOMEPAGE_SOCIAL_PREVIEW_OPTIONS[language]).toMatchObject({ artwork: 'agenda', hostname: 'ptbk.io', title: definition.socialTitle });
+        expect(resolveSocialPreviewImagePath(definition)).toBe(`/${language}/opengraph-image?v=2&content=agendas-1`);
+    });
+    it('keeps the preserved offer and authored previews independent of the homepage revision', () => {
+        expect(PRO_FIRMY_METADATA.alternates?.canonical).toBe('https://ptbk.io/cs/pro-firmy');
+        expect(JSON.stringify(PRO_FIRMY_METADATA)).toContain('virtuálního zaměstnance');
+        expect(JSON.stringify(PRO_FIRMY_METADATA)).not.toContain('agendas-1');
+        expect(resolveSocialPreviewImagePath({ ...HOMEPAGE_PAGE_DEFINITIONS.en, socialPreviewImagePath: '/authored.png' })).toBe('/authored.png');
+    });
+});

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..66bb89d46e6aa4d9c651472144b4133540b6e57e
