diff --git a/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md b/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..b821f57938c5853034ac64c8b8007eb79fd73331
--- /dev/null
+++ b/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md
@@ -0,0 +1,49 @@
+# Autonomous agendas homepage
+
+The Czech `/cs` and English `/en` pages present ongoing business responsibilities and an enquiry about deployment.
+The shared composition lives in `businesses/homepage/HomepagePage.tsx`; Czech is the content source of truth.
+The September homepage proposal remains deferred and unchanged.
+
+## Analysis and implementation
+
+Before this change, both routes rendered `ProFirmyPage`, while their metadata already had its own module.
+The company offer owns its document Q&A proposition, shared qualification defaults and canonical `/cs/pro-firmy`
+address. The new homepage therefore has its own content and styles. The whitepaper's semantic controls and CSS
+perspective informed the presentation; none of its chapters, interactions or page styles were replaced.
+
+Whitepaper chapters 1 and 7 supply the shift to ongoing responsibility, chapter 11 supplies the three examples,
+and chapters 10 and 12 supply the approval boundaries and distinction between capabilities and vision. The page
+labels these as fictional illustrations of the direction being developed. It makes no measured customer-result,
+integration-availability, guaranteed-compliance or autonomous-payment claims.
+
+- `homepageScenarios.ts` supplies the interactive stories, readable native-disclosure summaries and enquiry choices.
+  Every scenario has a burden, entrusted responsibility, benefit, owner decision and five finite story moments.
+- `homepageStoryModel.ts` selects one scenario and step. The first view is a prepared result; selecting a scenario
+  resets to that view. Replay returns to the incoming need. Nothing accumulates, runs on a timer or calls a service.
+  Software proposals remain unpublished, customer responses remain unsent, and accounting inputs await review.
+- The layered agent, project and task surfaces are semantic buttons for those same story states. Their grid layout
+  gives text its own space at narrow widths and zoom. Scroll changes only perspective and lift. Its optional controller
+  unmounts offscreen, in a hidden document and for reduced motion. Direct controls remain immediate.
+- Hero, initial story, benefits, summaries and contact links are server-rendered. An error boundary contains failures
+  in the story. If client scripts or the enquiry handler are unavailable, the primary action keeps its native contact
+  anchor; the contact section links to the existing contact page.
+- `QualificationPopup` accepts an optional presentation. Without it, the original company form remains unchanged.
+  The homepage uses `subscribeToWaitlist`, the existing `qualification-popup` source, attribution and consent note.
+  It retains drafts on close/failure, validates locally, disables pending edits and fences duplicate submissions.
+  Success uses `/dekujeme?source=autonomous-agendas&lang=cs|en` without contact identity in the URL.
+- The full shared footer retains legal and funding information. Its optional claim and product links affect only
+  callers that supply them. Homepage metadata uses an `agenda` illustration and a page-specific content revision in
+  addition to the shared image version. Authored preview URLs and other pages' artwork are unchanged.
+
+## Preservation
+
+No changes to the company composition/content/metadata, whitepaper sources, root language selector, domain routing
+or deferred September PRD are needed. The legacy company redirect and canonical Czech-only offer remain in place.
+Rendered main text and Open Graph/X/canonical/alternate metadata are compared against the saved pre-change baseline
+for `/cs/pro-firmy`, `/cs/whitepaper` and `/en/whitepaper`. Shared-form preservation also has a browser submission test.
+
+## Verification
+
+Verification results and observed browser measurements are recorded here after the final checks. Browser test
+requests use the real local API with isolated in-memory contacts; failure/retry tests intercept their own requests.
+They do not prove production delivery, physical-device behavior or the availability of the illustrated integrations.

+        test('touch controls and artifact text remain usable at phone, tablet and desktop widths', async ({ page }) => {
+            await page.goto(`/${language}`);
+            const story = page.getByTestId('homepage-story');
+            for (const width of [320, 375, 768, 1440]) {
+                await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 900 });
+                for (const scenario of SCENARIOS) {
+                    await story.getByRole('button', { name: new RegExp(scenario.name) }).tap();
+                    for (const [index, step] of scenario.steps.entries()) {
+                        await story.locator('.ah-story-steps button').nth(index).tap();
+                        await expect(story.locator('.ah-step-result')).toHaveText(
+                            `${CONTENT.story.result}${step.result}`,
+                        );
+                        const coveredText = await story.evaluate((element) => {
+                            const task = element.querySelector('.ah-task')!.getBoundingClientRect();
+                            return [
+                                ...element.querySelectorAll(
+                                    '.ah-artifact-detail, .ah-artifact-title, .ah-message, .ah-mini-form, .ah-document-list',
+                                ),
+                            ].flatMap((artifact) => {
+                                const range = document.createRange();
+                                range.selectNodeContents(artifact);
+                                const isCovered = [...range.getClientRects()].some(
+                                    (rectangle) =>
+                                        rectangle.left < task.right &&
+                                        rectangle.right > task.left &&
+                                        rectangle.top < task.bottom &&
+                                        rectangle.bottom > task.top,
+                                );
+                                return isCovered ? [artifact.textContent] : [];
+                            });
+                        });
+                        expect(coveredText, `${width}px / ${scenario.id} / ${step.label}`).toEqual([]);
+                    }
+                }
+                expect(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth)).toBe(true);
+            }
+            // Each layered surface is a direct story control, never an action that runs the illustrated work.
+            for (const [label, stepIndex] of [
+                [CONTENT.story.projectAction, 1],
+                [CONTENT.story.agentAction, 3],
+                [CONTENT.story.taskAction, 2],
+            ] as const) {
+                await story.getByRole('button', { name: label, exact: true }).tap();
+                await expect(story).toHaveAttribute('data-step', String(stepIndex));
+            }
+        });
+    });

+const { chromium, expect } = require('@playwright/test');
+const fs = require('node:fs/promises');
+
+const BASE_URL = process.env.HOMEPAGE_REVIEW_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:4010';
+const OUTPUT = '.tmp/homepage-final-review';
+
+(async () => {
+    await fs.mkdir(OUTPUT, { recursive: true });
+    const browser = await chromium.launch();
+    const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 1000 }, hasTouch: true });
+    await context.addInitScript(() => {
+        localStorage.setItem('cookiesAccepted', 'true');
+        localStorage.setItem('cookiePreferences', JSON.stringify({ necessary: true, analytics: false, marketing: false }));
+        window.homepageReview = { layoutShift: 0, longTasks: [], largestContentfulPaint: 0 };
+        new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
+            for (const entry of list.getEntries()) if (!entry.hadRecentInput) window.homepageReview.layoutShift += entry.value;
+        }).observe({ type: 'layout-shift', buffered: true });
+        new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
+            window.homepageReview.longTasks.push(...list.getEntries().map((entry) => entry.duration));
+        }).observe({ type: 'longtask', buffered: true });
+        new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
+            window.homepageReview.largestContentfulPaint = list.getEntries().at(-1).startTime;
+        }).observe({ type: 'largest-contentful-paint', buffered: true });
+    });
+    const page = await context.newPage();
+    const results = {};
+    for (const language of ['cs', 'en']) {
+        await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1440, height: 1000 });
+        await page.goto(`${BASE_URL}/${language}`, { timeout: 180000 });
+        await expect(page.locator('.ah-scenario-picker button').first()).toBeEnabled();
+        await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
+        await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-desktop.png`, fullPage: true });
+        results[language] = { desktop: await page.evaluate(() => ({ ...window.homepageReview,
+            scriptBytes: performance.getEntriesByType('resource').filter((entry) => entry.initiatorType === 'script').reduce((sum, entry) => sum + entry.encodedBodySize, 0),
+            firstContentfulPaint: performance.getEntriesByName('first-contentful-paint')[0]?.startTime,
+        })) };
+        await page.locator('#agendas').scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+        await expect.poll(() => page.locator('.ah-story-panel').evaluate((element) => element.style.getPropertyValue('--ah-tilt'))).not.toBe('');
+        const before = await page.locator('.ah-scene-stack').evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).transform);
+        await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollBy({ top: 180, behavior: 'instant' }));
+        await expect.poll(() => page.locator('.ah-scene-stack').evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).transform)).not.toBe(before);
+        results[language].isScrollDepthChanged = true;
+        await page.setViewportSize({ width: 375, height: 812 });
+        await page.goto(`${BASE_URL}/${language}`);
+        await expect(page.locator('.ah-scenario-picker button').first()).toBeEnabled();
+        await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
+        await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-hero.png` });
+        results[language].phone = await page.evaluate(() => ({ ...window.homepageReview,
+            firstContentfulPaint: performance.getEntriesByName('first-contentful-paint')[0]?.startTime,
+        }));
+        const heights = [];
+        for (let scenario = 0; scenario < 3; scenario++) {
+            await page.locator('.ah-scenario-picker button').nth(scenario).tap();
+            await page.locator('.ah-scene').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-example-${scenario}.png` });
+            for (let step = 0; step < 5; step++) {
+                await page.locator('.ah-story-steps button').nth(step).tap();
+                heights.push(Math.round((await page.locator('.ah-experience').boundingBox()).height));
+            }
+        }
+        results[language].phoneStoryHeightRange = [Math.min(...heights), Math.max(...heights)];
+        await page.locator('#hero-cta').click();
+        await page.getByRole('dialog').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-form-top.png` });
+        await page.getByRole('dialog').getByRole('button', { name: language === 'cs' ? 'Odeslat a probrat nasazení' : 'Send enquiry and discuss deployment', exact: true }).scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+        await page.getByRole('dialog').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-form-bottom.png` });
+        await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
+        results[language].isFocusRestored = await page.locator('#hero-cta').evaluate((element) => document.activeElement === element);
+        await page.locator('footer').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-footer.png` });
+        for (const width of [320, 720, 900, 1024]) {
+            await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 900 });
+            expect(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth)).toBe(true);
+        }
+        const imageResponse = await context.request.get(`${BASE_URL}/${language}/opengraph-image?v=2&content=agendas-1`);
+        await fs.writeFile(`${OUTPUT}/${language}-social.png`, await imageResponse.body());
+    }
+    const cookieContext = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 375, height: 812 } });
+    const cookiePage = await cookieContext.newPage();
+    await cookiePage.goto(`${BASE_URL}/cs`);
+    await expect(cookiePage.locator('[data-cookie-consent-panel]')).toBeVisible();
+    await cookiePage.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/cs-cookie-hero.png` });
+    await cookiePage.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo({ top: document.body.scrollHeight, behavior: 'instant' }));
+    await cookiePage.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/cs-cookie-footer.png` });
+    const footer = await cookiePage.locator('footer').boundingBox();
+    const cookiePanel = await cookiePage.locator('[data-cookie-consent-panel]').boundingBox();
+    results.cookies = { isFooterClear: footer.y + footer.height <= cookiePanel.y, panelHeight: cookiePanel.height };
+    await cookiePage.locator('#hero-cta').click();
+    await expect(cookiePage.getByRole('dialog')).toBeVisible();
+    await cookiePage.getByRole('dialog').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/cs-cookie-form.png` });
+    await fs.writeFile(`${OUTPUT}/measurements.json`, JSON.stringify(results, null, 2));
+    console.log(JSON.stringify(results, null, 2));
+    await browser.close();
+})().catch((error) => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; });

diff --git a/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md b/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..b821f57938c5853034ac64c8b8007eb79fd73331
--- /dev/null
+++ b/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md
@@ -0,0 +1,49 @@
+# Autonomous agendas homepage
+
+The Czech `/cs` and English `/en` pages present ongoing business responsibilities and an enquiry about deployment.
+The shared composition lives in `businesses/homepage/HomepagePage.tsx`; Czech is the content source of truth.
+The September homepage proposal remains deferred and unchanged.
+
+## Analysis and implementation
+
+Before this change, both routes rendered `ProFirmyPage`, while their metadata already had its own module.
+The company offer owns its document Q&A proposition, shared qualification defaults and canonical `/cs/pro-firmy`
+address. The new homepage therefore has its own content and styles. The whitepaper's semantic controls and CSS
+perspective informed the presentation; none of its chapters, interactions or page styles were replaced.
+
+Whitepaper chapters 1 and 7 supply the shift to ongoing responsibility, chapter 11 supplies the three examples,
+and chapters 10 and 12 supply the approval boundaries and distinction between capabilities and vision. The page
+labels these as fictional illustrations of the direction being developed. It makes no measured customer-result,
+integration-availability, guaranteed-compliance or autonomous-payment claims.
+
+- `homepageScenarios.ts` supplies the interactive stories, readable native-disclosure summaries and enquiry choices.
+  Every scenario has a burden, entrusted responsibility, benefit, owner decision and five finite story moments.
+- `homepageStoryModel.ts` selects one scenario and step. The first view is a prepared result; selecting a scenario
+  resets to that view. Replay returns to the incoming need. Nothing accumulates, runs on a timer or calls a service.
+  Software proposals remain unpublished, customer responses remain unsent, and accounting inputs await review.
+- The layered agent, project and task surfaces are semantic buttons for those same story states. Their grid layout
+  gives text its own space at narrow widths and zoom. Scroll changes only perspective and lift. Its optional controller
+  unmounts offscreen, in a hidden document and for reduced motion. Direct controls remain immediate.
+- Hero, initial story, benefits, summaries and contact links are server-rendered. An error boundary contains failures
+  in the story. If client scripts or the enquiry handler are unavailable, the primary action keeps its native contact
+  anchor; the contact section links to the existing contact page.
+- `QualificationPopup` accepts an optional presentation. Without it, the original company form remains unchanged.
+  The homepage uses `subscribeToWaitlist`, the existing `qualification-popup` source, attribution and consent note.
+  It retains drafts on close/failure, validates locally, disables pending edits and fences duplicate submissions.
+  Success uses `/dekujeme?source=autonomous-agendas&lang=cs|en` without contact identity in the URL.
+- The full shared footer retains legal and funding information. Its optional claim and product links affect only
+  callers that supply them. Homepage metadata uses an `agenda` illustration and a page-specific content revision in
+  addition to the shared image version. Authored preview URLs and other pages' artwork are unchanged.
+
+## Preservation
+
+No changes to the company composition/content/metadata, whitepaper sources, root language selector, domain routing
+or deferred September PRD are needed. The legacy company redirect and canonical Czech-only offer remain in place.
+Rendered main text and Open Graph/X/canonical/alternate metadata are compared against the saved pre-change baseline
+for `/cs/pro-firmy`, `/cs/whitepaper` and `/en/whitepaper`. Shared-form preservation also has a browser submission test.
+
+## Verification
+
+Verification results and observed browser measurements are recorded here after the final checks. Browser test
+requests use the real local API with isolated in-memory contacts; failure/retry tests intercept their own requests.
+They do not prove production delivery, physical-device behavior or the availability of the illustrated integrations.

+const { chromium, expect } = require('@playwright/test');
+const fs = require('node:fs/promises');
+
+const BASE_URL = process.env.HOMEPAGE_REVIEW_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:4010';
+const OUTPUT = '.tmp/homepage-final-review';
+
+(async () => {
+    await fs.mkdir(OUTPUT, { recursive: true });
+    const browser = await chromium.launch();
+    const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 1000 }, hasTouch: true });
+    await context.addInitScript(() => {
+        localStorage.setItem('cookiesAccepted', 'true');
+        localStorage.setItem('cookiePreferences', JSON.stringify({ necessary: true, analytics: false, marketing: false }));
+        window.homepageReview = { layoutShift: 0, longTasks: [], largestContentfulPaint: 0 };
+        new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
+            for (const entry of list.getEntries()) if (!entry.hadRecentInput) window.homepageReview.layoutShift += entry.value;
+        }).observe({ type: 'layout-shift', buffered: true });
+        new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
+            window.homepageReview.longTasks.push(...list.getEntries().map((entry) => entry.duration));
+        }).observe({ type: 'longtask', buffered: true });
+        new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
+            window.homepageReview.largestContentfulPaint = list.getEntries().at(-1).startTime;
+        }).observe({ type: 'largest-contentful-paint', buffered: true });
+    });
+    const page = await context.newPage();
+    const results = {};
+    for (const language of ['cs', 'en']) {
+        await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1440, height: 1000 });
+        await page.goto(`${BASE_URL}/${language}`, { timeout: 180000 });
+        await expect(page.locator('.ah-scenario-picker button').first()).toBeEnabled();

diff --git a/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md b/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..b821f57938c5853034ac64c8b8007eb79fd73331
--- /dev/null
+++ b/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md
@@ -0,0 +1,49 @@
+# Autonomous agendas homepage
+
+The Czech `/cs` and English `/en` pages present ongoing business responsibilities and an enquiry about deployment.
+The shared composition lives in `businesses/homepage/HomepagePage.tsx`; Czech is the content source of truth.
+The September homepage proposal remains deferred and unchanged.
+
+## Analysis and implementation
+
+Before this change, both routes rendered `ProFirmyPage`, while their metadata already had its own module.
+The company offer owns its document Q&A proposition, shared qualification defaults and canonical `/cs/pro-firmy`
+address. The new homepage therefore has its own content and styles. The whitepaper's semantic controls and CSS
+perspective informed the presentation; none of its chapters, interactions or page styles were replaced.
+
+Whitepaper chapters 1 and 7 supply the shift to ongoing responsibility, chapter 11 supplies the three examples,
+and chapters 10 and 12 supply the approval boundaries and distinction between capabilities and vision. The page
+labels these as fictional illustrations of the direction being developed. It makes no measured customer-result,
+integration-availability, guaranteed-compliance or autonomous-payment claims.
+
+- `homepageScenarios.ts` supplies the interactive stories, readable native-disclosure summaries and enquiry choices.
+  Every scenario has a burden, entrusted responsibility, benefit, owner decision and five finite story moments.
+- `homepageStoryModel.ts` selects one scenario and step. The first view is a prepared result; selecting a scenario
+  resets to that view. Replay returns to the incoming need. Nothing accumulates, runs on a timer or calls a service.
+  Software proposals remain unpublished, customer responses remain unsent, and accounting inputs await review.
+- The layered agent, project and task surfaces are semantic buttons for those same story states. Their grid layout
+  gives text its own space at narrow widths and zoom. Scroll changes only perspective and lift. Its optional controller
+  unmounts offscreen, in a hidden document and for reduced motion. Direct controls remain immediate.
+- Hero, initial story, benefits, summaries and contact links are server-rendered. An error boundary contains failures
+  in the story. If client scripts or the enquiry handler are unavailable, the primary action keeps its native contact
+  anchor; the contact section links to the existing contact page.
+- `QualificationPopup` accepts an optional presentation. Without it, the original company form remains unchanged.
+  The homepage uses `subscribeToWaitlist`, the existing `qualification-popup` source, attribution and consent note.
+  It retains drafts on close/failure, validates locally, disables pending edits and fences duplicate submissions.
+  Success uses `/dekujeme?source=autonomous-agendas&lang=cs|en` without contact identity in the URL.
+- The full shared footer retains legal and funding information. Its optional claim and product links affect only
+  callers that supply them. Homepage metadata uses an `agenda` illustration and a page-specific content revision in
+  addition to the shared image version. Authored preview URLs and other pages' artwork are unchanged.
+
+## Preservation
+
+No changes to the company composition/content/metadata, whitepaper sources, root language selector, domain routing
+or deferred September PRD are needed. The legacy company redirect and canonical Czech-only offer remain in place.
+Rendered main text and Open Graph/X/canonical/alternate metadata are compared against the saved pre-change baseline
+for `/cs/pro-firmy`, `/cs/whitepaper` and `/en/whitepaper`. Shared-form preservation also has a browser submission test.
+
+## Verification
+
+Verification results and observed browser measurements are recorded here after the final checks. Browser test
+requests use the real local API with isolated in-memory contacts; failure/retry tests intercept their own requests.
+They do not prove production delivery, physical-device behavior or the availability of the illustrated integrations.

+const { chromium, expect } = require('@playwright/test');

+
+(async () => {
+    await fs.mkdir(OUTPUT, { recursive: true });

+    await context.addInitScript(() => {
+        localStorage.setItem('cookiesAccepted', 'true');

+        window.homepageReview = { layoutShift: 0, longTasks: [], largestContentfulPaint: 0 };
+        new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
+            for (const entry of list.getEntries()) if (!entry.hadRecentInput) window.homepageReview.layoutShift += entry.value;
+        }).observe({ type: 'layout-shift', buffered: true });
+        new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
+            window.homepageReview.longTasks.push(...list.getEntries().map((entry) => entry.duration));
+        }).observe({ type: 'longtask', buffered: true });
+        new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
+            window.homepageReview.largestContentfulPaint = list.getEntries().at(-1).startTime;
+        }).observe({ type: 'largest-contentful-paint', buffered: true });
+    });
+    const page = await context.newPage();
+    const results = {};
+    for (const language of ['cs', 'en']) {
+        await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1440, height: 1000 });
+        await page.goto(`${BASE_URL}/${language}`, { timeout: 180000 });
+        await expect(page.locator('.ah-scenario-picker button').first()).toBeEnabled();
+        await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
+        await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-desktop.png`, fullPage: true });
+        results[language] = { desktop: await page.evaluate(() => ({ ...window.homepageReview,
+            scriptBytes: performance.getEntriesByType('resource').filter((entry) => entry.initiatorType === 'script').reduce((sum, entry) => sum + entry.encodedBodySize, 0),
+            firstContentfulPaint: performance.getEntriesByName('first-contentful-paint')[0]?.startTime,
+        })) };
+        await page.locator('#agendas').scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+        await expect.poll(() => page.locator('.ah-story-panel').evaluate((element) => element.style.getPropertyValue('--ah-tilt'))).not.toBe('');
+        const before = await page.locator('.ah-scene-stack').evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).transform);
+        await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollBy({ top: 180, behavior: 'instant' }));
+        await expect.poll(() => page.locator('.ah-scene-stack').evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).transform)).not.toBe(before);
+        results[language].isScrollDepthChanged = true;
+        await page.setViewportSize({ width: 375, height: 812 });
+        await page.goto(`${BASE_URL}/${language}`);
+        await expect(page.locator('.ah-scenario-picker button').first()).toBeEnabled();
+        await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
+        await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-hero.png` });
+        results[language].phone = await page.evaluate(() => ({ ...window.homepageReview,
+            firstContentfulPaint: performance.getEntriesByName('first-contentful-paint')[0]?.startTime,
+        }));
+        const heights = [];
+        for (let scenario = 0; scenario < 3; scenario++) {
+            await page.locator('.ah-scenario-picker button').nth(scenario).tap();
+            await page.locator('.ah-scene').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-example-${scenario}.png` });
+            for (let step = 0; step < 5; step++) {
+                await page.locator('.ah-story-steps button').nth(step).tap();
+                heights.push(Math.round((await page.locator('.ah-experience').boundingBox()).height));
+            }
+        }
+        results[language].phoneStoryHeightRange = [Math.min(...heights), Math.max(...heights)];
+        await page.locator('#hero-cta').click();
+        await page.getByRole('dialog').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-form-top.png` });
+        await page.getByRole('dialog').getByRole('button', { name: language === 'cs' ? 'Odeslat a probrat nasazení' : 'Send enquiry and discuss deployment', exact: true }).scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+        await page.getByRole('dialog').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-form-bottom.png` });
+        await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
+        results[language].isFocusRestored = await page.locator('#hero-cta').evaluate((element) => document.activeElement === element);
+        await page.locator('footer').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-footer.png` });
+        for (const width of [320, 720, 900, 1024]) {
+            await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 900 });
+            expect(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth)).toBe(true);
+        }
+        const imageResponse = await context.request.get(`${BASE_URL}/${language}/opengraph-image?v=2&content=agendas-1`);
+        await fs.writeFile(`${OUTPUT}/${language}-social.png`, await imageResponse.body());
+    }
+    const cookieContext = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 375, height: 812 } });
+    const cookiePage = await cookieContext.newPage();
+    await cookiePage.goto(`${BASE_URL}/cs`);
+    await expect(cookiePage.locator('[data-cookie-consent-panel]')).toBeVisible();
+    await cookiePage.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/cs-cookie-hero.png` });
+    await cookiePage.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo({ top: document.body.scrollHeight, behavior: 'instant' }));
+    await cookiePage.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/cs-cookie-footer.png` });
+    const footer = await cookiePage.locator('footer').boundingBox();
+    const cookiePanel = await cookiePage.locator('[data-cookie-consent-panel]').boundingBox();
+    results.cookies = { isFooterClear: footer.y + footer.height <= cookiePanel.y, panelHeight: cookiePanel.height };
+    await cookiePage.locator('#hero-cta').click();
+    await expect(cookiePage.getByRole('dialog')).toBeVisible();
+    await cookiePage.getByRole('dialog').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/cs-cookie-form.png` });
+    await fs.writeFile(`${OUTPUT}/measurements.json`, JSON.stringify(results, null, 2));
+    console.log(JSON.stringify(results, null, 2));
+    await browser.close();
+})().catch((error) => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; });

diff --git a/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md b/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..b821f57938c5853034ac64c8b8007eb79fd73331
--- /dev/null
+++ b/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md
@@ -0,0 +1,49 @@
+# Autonomous agendas homepage
+
+The Czech `/cs` and English `/en` pages present ongoing business responsibilities and an enquiry about deployment.
+The shared composition lives in `businesses/homepage/HomepagePage.tsx`; Czech is the content source of truth.
+The September homepage proposal remains deferred and unchanged.
+
+## Analysis and implementation
+
+Before this change, both routes rendered `ProFirmyPage`, while their metadata already had its own module.
+The company offer owns its document Q&A proposition, shared qualification defaults and canonical `/cs/pro-firmy`
+address. The new homepage therefore has its own content and styles. The whitepaper's semantic controls and CSS
+perspective informed the presentation; none of its chapters, interactions or page styles were replaced.
+
+Whitepaper chapters 1 and 7 supply the shift to ongoing responsibility, chapter 11 supplies the three examples,
+and chapters 10 and 12 supply the approval boundaries and distinction between capabilities and vision. The page
+labels these as fictional illustrations of the direction being developed. It makes no measured customer-result,
+integration-availability, guaranteed-compliance or autonomous-payment claims.
+
+- `homepageScenarios.ts` supplies the interactive stories, readable native-disclosure summaries and enquiry choices.
+  Every scenario has a burden, entrusted responsibility, benefit, owner decision and five finite story moments.
+- `homepageStoryModel.ts` selects one scenario and step. The first view is a prepared result; selecting a scenario
+  resets to that view. Replay returns to the incoming need. Nothing accumulates, runs on a timer or calls a service.
+  Software proposals remain unpublished, customer responses remain unsent, and accounting inputs await review.
+- The layered agent, project and task surfaces are semantic buttons for those same story states. Their grid layout
+  gives text its own space at narrow widths and zoom. Scroll changes only perspective and lift. Its optional controller
+  unmounts offscreen, in a hidden document and for reduced motion. Direct controls remain immediate.
+- Hero, initial story, benefits, summaries and contact links are server-rendered. An error boundary contains failures
+  in the story. If client scripts or the enquiry handler are unavailable, the primary action keeps its native contact
+  anchor; the contact section links to the existing contact page.
+- `QualificationPopup` accepts an optional presentation. Without it, the original company form remains unchanged.
+  The homepage uses `subscribeToWaitlist`, the existing `qualification-popup` source, attribution and consent note.
+  It retains drafts on close/failure, validates locally, disables pending edits and fences duplicate submissions.
+  Success uses `/dekujeme?source=autonomous-agendas&lang=cs|en` without contact identity in the URL.
+- The full shared footer retains legal and funding information. Its optional claim and product links affect only
+  callers that supply them. Homepage metadata uses an `agenda` illustration and a page-specific content revision in
+  addition to the shared image version. Authored preview URLs and other pages' artwork are unchanged.
+
+## Preservation
+
+No changes to the company composition/content/metadata, whitepaper sources, root language selector, domain routing
+or deferred September PRD are needed. The legacy company redirect and canonical Czech-only offer remain in place.
+Rendered main text and Open Graph/X/canonical/alternate metadata are compared against the saved pre-change baseline
+for `/cs/pro-firmy`, `/cs/whitepaper` and `/en/whitepaper`. Shared-form preservation also has a browser submission test.
+
+## Verification
+
+Verification results and observed browser measurements are recorded here after the final checks. Browser test
+requests use the real local API with isolated in-memory contacts; failure/retry tests intercept their own requests.
+They do not prove production delivery, physical-device behavior or the availability of the illustrated integrations.

+                [CONTENT.story.agentAction, 3],
+                [CONTENT.story.taskAction, 2],

+            }
+        });
+    });
 }

diff --git a/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md b/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..b821f57938c5853034ac64c8b8007eb79fd73331
--- /dev/null
+++ b/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md
@@ -0,0 +1,49 @@
+# Autonomous agendas homepage
+
+The Czech `/cs` and English `/en` pages present ongoing business responsibilities and an enquiry about deployment.
+The shared composition lives in `businesses/homepage/HomepagePage.tsx`; Czech is the content source of truth.
+The September homepage proposal remains deferred and unchanged.
+
+## Analysis and implementation
+
+Before this change, both routes rendered `ProFirmyPage`, while their metadata already had its own module.
+The company offer owns its document Q&A proposition, shared qualification defaults and canonical `/cs/pro-firmy`
+address. The new homepage therefore has its own content and styles. The whitepaper's semantic controls and CSS
+perspective informed the presentation; none of its chapters, interactions or page styles were replaced.
+
+Whitepaper chapters 1 and 7 supply the shift to ongoing responsibility, chapter 11 supplies the three examples,
+and chapters 10 and 12 supply the approval boundaries and distinction between capabilities and vision. The page
+labels these as fictional illustrations of the direction being developed. It makes no measured customer-result,
+integration-availability, guaranteed-compliance or autonomous-payment claims.
+
+- `homepageScenarios.ts` supplies the interactive stories, readable native-disclosure summaries and enquiry choices.
+  Every scenario has a burden, entrusted responsibility, benefit, owner decision and five finite story moments.
+- `homepageStoryModel.ts` selects one scenario and step. The first view is a prepared result; selecting a scenario
+  resets to that view. Replay returns to the incoming need. Nothing accumulates, runs on a timer or calls a service.
+  Software proposals remain unpublished, customer responses remain unsent, and accounting inputs await review.
+- The layered agent, project and task surfaces are semantic buttons for those same story states. Their grid layout
+  gives text its own space at narrow widths and zoom. Scroll changes only perspective and lift. Its optional controller
+  unmounts offscreen, in a hidden document and for reduced motion. Direct controls remain immediate.
+- Hero, initial story, benefits, summaries and contact links are server-rendered. An error boundary contains failures
+  in the story. If client scripts or the enquiry handler are unavailable, the primary action keeps its native contact
+  anchor; the contact section links to the existing contact page.
+- `QualificationPopup` accepts an optional presentation. Without it, the original company form remains unchanged.
+  The homepage uses `subscribeToWaitlist`, the existing `qualification-popup` source, attribution and consent note.
+  It retains drafts on close/failure, validates locally, disables pending edits and fences duplicate submissions.
+  Success uses `/dekujeme?source=autonomous-agendas&lang=cs|en` without contact identity in the URL.
+- The full shared footer retains legal and funding information. Its optional claim and product links affect only
+  callers that supply them. Homepage metadata uses an `agenda` illustration and a page-specific content revision in
+  addition to the shared image version. Authored preview URLs and other pages' artwork are unchanged.
+
+## Preservation
+
+No changes to the company composition/content/metadata, whitepaper sources, root language selector, domain routing
+or deferred September PRD are needed. The legacy company redirect and canonical Czech-only offer remain in place.
+Rendered main text and Open Graph/X/canonical/alternate metadata are compared against the saved pre-change baseline
+for `/cs/pro-firmy`, `/cs/whitepaper` and `/en/whitepaper`. Shared-form preservation also has a browser submission test.
+
+## Verification
+
+Verification results and observed browser measurements are recorded here after the final checks. Browser test
+requests use the real local API with isolated in-memory contacts; failure/retry tests intercept their own requests.
+They do not prove production delivery, physical-device behavior or the availability of the illustrated integrations.

                }}
            />

            {/* Animated glow spots */}
            <div
                className="absolute top-[30%] left-[20%] w-[300px] h-[300px] rounded-full bg-cyan-400/[0.08] blur-[100px]"

+(async () => {

+            window.homepageReview.longTasks.push(...list.getEntries().map((entry) => entry.duration));
+        }).observe({ type: 'longtask', buffered: true });
+        new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
+            window.homepageReview.largestContentfulPaint = list.getEntries().at(-1).startTime;
+        }).observe({ type: 'largest-contentful-paint', buffered: true });
+    });
+    const page = await context.newPage();

+        await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
+        await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-desktop.png`, fullPage: true });
+        results[language] = { desktop: await page.evaluate(() => ({ ...window.homepageReview,
+            scriptBytes: performance.getEntriesByType('resource').filter((entry) => entry.initiatorType === 'script').reduce((sum, entry) => sum + entry.encodedBodySize, 0),
+            firstContentfulPaint: performance.getEntriesByName('first-contentful-paint')[0]?.startTime,
+        })) };
+        await page.locator('#agendas').scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+        await expect.poll(() => page.locator('.ah-story-panel').evaluate((element) => element.style.getPropertyValue('--ah-tilt'))).not.toBe('');
+        const before = await page.locator('.ah-scene-stack').evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).transform);
+        await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollBy({ top: 180, behavior: 'instant' }));
+        await expect.poll(() => page.locator('.ah-scene-stack').evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).transform)).not.toBe(before);
+        results[language].isScrollDepthChanged = true;
+        await page.setViewportSize({ width: 375, height: 812 });
+        await page.goto(`${BASE_URL}/${language}`);
+        await expect(page.locator('.ah-scenario-picker button').first()).toBeEnabled();
+        await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
+        await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-hero.png` });
+        results[language].phone = await page.evaluate(() => ({ ...window.homepageReview,
+            firstContentfulPaint: performance.getEntriesByName('first-contentful-paint')[0]?.startTime,
+        }));
+        const heights = [];
+        for (let scenario = 0; scenario < 3; scenario++) {
+            await page.locator('.ah-scenario-picker button').nth(scenario).tap();
+            await page.locator('.ah-scene').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-example-${scenario}.png` });
+            for (let step = 0; step < 5; step++) {
+                await page.locator('.ah-story-steps button').nth(step).tap();
+                heights.push(Math.round((await page.locator('.ah-experience').boundingBox()).height));
+            }
+        }
+        results[language].phoneStoryHeightRange = [Math.min(...heights), Math.max(...heights)];
+        await page.locator('#hero-cta').click();
+        await page.getByRole('dialog').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-form-top.png` });
+        await page.getByRole('dialog').getByRole('button', { name: language === 'cs' ? 'Odeslat a probrat nasazení' : 'Send enquiry and discuss deployment', exact: true }).scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+        await page.getByRole('dialog').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-form-bottom.png` });
+        await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
+        results[language].isFocusRestored = await page.locator('#hero-cta').evaluate((element) => document.activeElement === element);
+        await page.locator('footer').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-footer.png` });
+        for (const width of [320, 720, 900, 1024]) {
+            await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 900 });
+            expect(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth)).toBe(true);
+        }
+        const imageResponse = await context.request.get(`${BASE_URL}/${language}/opengraph-image?v=2&content=agendas-1`);
+        await fs.writeFile(`${OUTPUT}/${language}-social.png`, await imageResponse.body());
+    }
+    const cookieContext = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 375, height: 812 } });
+    const cookiePage = await cookieContext.newPage();
+    await cookiePage.goto(`${BASE_URL}/cs`);

+    await cookiePage.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/cs-cookie-hero.png` });

+    await browser.close();

diff --git a/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md b/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..b821f57938c5853034ac64c8b8007eb79fd73331
--- /dev/null
+++ b/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md
@@ -0,0 +1,49 @@
+# Autonomous agendas homepage
+
+The Czech `/cs` and English `/en` pages present ongoing business responsibilities and an enquiry about deployment.
+The shared composition lives in `businesses/homepage/HomepagePage.tsx`; Czech is the content source of truth.
+The September homepage proposal remains deferred and unchanged.
+
+## Analysis and implementation
+
+Before this change, both routes rendered `ProFirmyPage`, while their metadata already had its own module.
+The company offer owns its document Q&A proposition, shared qualification defaults and canonical `/cs/pro-firmy`
+address. The new homepage therefore has its own content and styles. The whitepaper's semantic controls and CSS
+perspective informed the presentation; none of its chapters, interactions or page styles were replaced.
+
+Whitepaper chapters 1 and 7 supply the shift to ongoing responsibility, chapter 11 supplies the three examples,
+and chapters 10 and 12 supply the approval boundaries and distinction between capabilities and vision. The page
+labels these as fictional illustrations of the direction being developed. It makes no measured customer-result,
+integration-availability, guaranteed-compliance or autonomous-payment claims.
+
+- `homepageScenarios.ts` supplies the interactive stories, readable native-disclosure summaries and enquiry choices.
+  Every scenario has a burden, entrusted responsibility, benefit, owner decision and five finite story moments.
+- `homepageStoryModel.ts` selects one scenario and step. The first view is a prepared result; selecting a scenario
+  resets to that view. Replay returns to the incoming need. Nothing accumulates, runs on a timer or calls a service.
+  Software proposals remain unpublished, customer responses remain unsent, and accounting inputs await review.
+- The layered agent, project and task surfaces are semantic buttons for those same story states. Their grid layout
+  gives text its own space at narrow widths and zoom. Scroll changes only perspective and lift. Its optional controller
+  unmounts offscreen, in a hidden document and for reduced motion. Direct controls remain immediate.
+- Hero, initial story, benefits, summaries and contact links are server-rendered. An error boundary contains failures
+  in the story. If client scripts or the enquiry handler are unavailable, the primary action keeps its native contact
+  anchor; the contact section links to the existing contact page.
+- `QualificationPopup` accepts an optional presentation. Without it, the original company form remains unchanged.
+  The homepage uses `subscribeToWaitlist`, the existing `qualification-popup` source, attribution and consent note.
+  It retains drafts on close/failure, validates locally, disables pending edits and fences duplicate submissions.
+  Success uses `/dekujeme?source=autonomous-agendas&lang=cs|en` without contact identity in the URL.
+- The full shared footer retains legal and funding information. Its optional claim and product links affect only
+  callers that supply them. Homepage metadata uses an `agenda` illustration and a page-specific content revision in
+  addition to the shared image version. Authored preview URLs and other pages' artwork are unchanged.
+
+## Preservation
+
+No changes to the company composition/content/metadata, whitepaper sources, root language selector, domain routing
+or deferred September PRD are needed. The legacy company redirect and canonical Czech-only offer remain in place.
+Rendered main text and Open Graph/X/canonical/alternate metadata are compared against the saved pre-change baseline
+for `/cs/pro-firmy`, `/cs/whitepaper` and `/en/whitepaper`. Shared-form preservation also has a browser submission test.
+
+## Verification
+
+Verification results and observed browser measurements are recorded here after the final checks. Browser test
+requests use the real local API with isolated in-memory contacts; failure/retry tests intercept their own requests.
+They do not prove production delivery, physical-device behavior or the availability of the illustrated integrations.

+                                        rectangle.right > task.left &&

+test('Promptbook keeps language routing, the legacy company redirect and independent sitemap entries', async ({
+    request,
+}) => {
+    for (const [acceptedLanguages, language] of [
+        ['cs-CZ,cs;q=0.9,en;q=0.5', 'cs'],
+        ['en-US,en;q=0.9', 'en'],
+    ]) {
+        const response = await request.get('/', {
+            headers: { 'x-forwarded-host': 'ptbk.io', 'Accept-Language': acceptedLanguages },

+        });
+        expect(response.status()).toBe(307);
+        expect(response.headers().location).toBe(`/${language}`);
+    }
+    const companyRedirect = await request.get('/pro-firmy', { maxRedirects: 0 });
+    expect(companyRedirect.status()).toBe(301);
+    expect(new URL(companyRedirect.headers().location).pathname).toBe('/cs/pro-firmy');
+    expect((await request.get('/en/pro-firmy')).status()).toBe(404);
+    const sitemap = await request.get('/sitemap.xml', { headers: { 'x-forwarded-host': 'ptbk.io' } });
+    expect(sitemap.status()).toBe(200);
+    const xml = await sitemap.text();
+    for (const path of ['/cs', '/en', '/cs/pro-firmy', '/cs/whitepaper', '/en/whitepaper']) {
+        expect(xml).toContain(`<loc>https://ptbk.io${path}</loc>`);
+    }
+    expect(xml).not.toContain('<loc>https://ptbk.io/en/pro-firmy</loc>');
+});

+const { chromium, expect } = require('@playwright/test');
+const fs = require('node:fs/promises');
+
+const BASE_URL = process.env.HOMEPAGE_REVIEW_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:4010';
+const OUTPUT = '.tmp/homepage-final-review';
+
+(async () => {
+    await fs.mkdir(OUTPUT, { recursive: true });
+    const browser = await chromium.launch();
+    const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 1000 }, hasTouch: true });
+    await context.addInitScript(() => {
+        localStorage.setItem('cookiesAccepted', 'true');
+        localStorage.setItem('cookiePreferences', JSON.stringify({ necessary: true, analytics: false, marketing: false }));
+        window.homepageReview = { layoutShift: 0, longTasks: [], largestContentfulPaint: 0 };
+        new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
+            for (const entry of list.getEntries()) if (!entry.hadRecentInput) window.homepageReview.layoutShift += entry.value;
+        }).observe({ type: 'layout-shift', buffered: true });
+        new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
+            window.homepageReview.longTasks.push(...list.getEntries().map((entry) => entry.duration));
+        }).observe({ type: 'longtask', buffered: true });
+        new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
+            window.homepageReview.largestContentfulPaint = list.getEntries().at(-1).startTime;
+        }).observe({ type: 'largest-contentful-paint', buffered: true });
+    });
+    const page = await context.newPage();
+    const results = {};
+    for (const language of ['cs', 'en']) {
+        await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1440, height: 1000 });
+        await page.goto(`${BASE_URL}/${language}`, { timeout: 180000 });
+        await expect(page.locator('.ah-scenario-picker button').first()).toBeEnabled();
+        await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
+        await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-desktop.png`, fullPage: true });
+        results[language] = { desktop: await page.evaluate(() => ({ ...window.homepageReview,
+            scriptBytes: performance.getEntriesByType('resource').filter((entry) => entry.initiatorType === 'script').reduce((sum, entry) => sum + entry.encodedBodySize, 0),
+            firstContentfulPaint: performance.getEntriesByName('first-contentful-paint')[0]?.startTime,
+        })) };
+        await page.locator('#agendas').scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+        await expect.poll(() => page.locator('.ah-story-panel').evaluate((element) => element.style.getPropertyValue('--ah-tilt'))).not.toBe('');
+        const before = await page.locator('.ah-scene-stack').evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).transform);
+        await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollBy({ top: 180, behavior: 'instant' }));
+        await expect.poll(() => page.locator('.ah-scene-stack').evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).transform)).not.toBe(before);
+        results[language].isScrollDepthChanged = true;
+        await page.setViewportSize({ width: 375, height: 812 });
+        await page.goto(`${BASE_URL}/${language}`);
+        await expect(page.locator('.ah-scenario-picker button').first()).toBeEnabled();
+        await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
+        await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-hero.png` });
+        results[language].phone = await page.evaluate(() => ({ ...window.homepageReview,
+            firstContentfulPaint: performance.getEntriesByName('first-contentful-paint')[0]?.startTime,
+        }));
+        const heights = [];
+        for (let scenario = 0; scenario < 3; scenario++) {
+            await page.locator('.ah-scenario-picker button').nth(scenario).tap();
+            await page.locator('.ah-scene').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-example-${scenario}.png` });
+            for (let step = 0; step < 5; step++) {
+                await page.locator('.ah-story-steps button').nth(step).tap();
+                heights.push(Math.round((await page.locator('.ah-experience').boundingBox()).height));
+            }
+        }
+        results[language].phoneStoryHeightRange = [Math.min(...heights), Math.max(...heights)];
+        await page.locator('#hero-cta').click();
+        await page.getByRole('dialog').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-form-top.png` });
+        await page.getByRole('dialog').getByRole('button', { name: language === 'cs' ? 'Odeslat a probrat nasazení' : 'Send enquiry and discuss deployment', exact: true }).scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+        await page.getByRole('dialog').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-form-bottom.png` });
+        await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
+        results[language].isFocusRestored = await page.locator('#hero-cta').evaluate((element) => document.activeElement === element);
+        await page.locator('footer').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-footer.png` });
+        for (const width of [320, 720, 900, 1024]) {
+            await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 900 });
+            expect(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth)).toBe(true);
+        }
+        const imageResponse = await context.request.get(`${BASE_URL}/${language}/opengraph-image?v=2&content=agendas-1`);
+        await fs.writeFile(`${OUTPUT}/${language}-social.png`, await imageResponse.body());
+    }
+    const cookieContext = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 375, height: 812 } });
+    const cookiePage = await cookieContext.newPage();
+    await cookiePage.goto(`${BASE_URL}/cs`);
+    await expect(cookiePage.locator('[data-cookie-consent-panel]')).toBeVisible();
+    await cookiePage.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/cs-cookie-hero.png` });
+    await cookiePage.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo({ top: document.body.scrollHeight, behavior: 'instant' }));
+    await cookiePage.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/cs-cookie-footer.png` });
+    const footer = await cookiePage.locator('footer').boundingBox();
+    const cookiePanel = await cookiePage.locator('[data-cookie-consent-panel]').boundingBox();
+    results.cookies = { isFooterClear: footer.y + footer.height <= cookiePanel.y, panelHeight: cookiePanel.height };
+    await cookiePage.locator('#hero-cta').click();
+    await expect(cookiePage.getByRole('dialog')).toBeVisible();
+    await cookiePage.getByRole('dialog').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/cs-cookie-form.png` });
+    await fs.writeFile(`${OUTPUT}/measurements.json`, JSON.stringify(results, null, 2));
+    console.log(JSON.stringify(results, null, 2));
+    await browser.close();
+})().catch((error) => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; });

diff --git a/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md b/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..b821f57938c5853034ac64c8b8007eb79fd73331
--- /dev/null
+++ b/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md
@@ -0,0 +1,49 @@
+# Autonomous agendas homepage
+
+The Czech `/cs` and English `/en` pages present ongoing business responsibilities and an enquiry about deployment.
+The shared composition lives in `businesses/homepage/HomepagePage.tsx`; Czech is the content source of truth.
+The September homepage proposal remains deferred and unchanged.
+
+## Analysis and implementation
+
+Before this change, both routes rendered `ProFirmyPage`, while their metadata already had its own module.
+The company offer owns its document Q&A proposition, shared qualification defaults and canonical `/cs/pro-firmy`
+address. The new homepage therefore has its own content and styles. The whitepaper's semantic controls and CSS
+perspective informed the presentation; none of its chapters, interactions or page styles were replaced.
+
+Whitepaper chapters 1 and 7 supply the shift to ongoing responsibility, chapter 11 supplies the three examples,
+and chapters 10 and 12 supply the approval boundaries and distinction between capabilities and vision. The page
+labels these as fictional illustrations of the direction being developed. It makes no measured customer-result,
+integration-availability, guaranteed-compliance or autonomous-payment claims.
+
+- `homepageScenarios.ts` supplies the interactive stories, readable native-disclosure summaries and enquiry choices.
+  Every scenario has a burden, entrusted responsibility, benefit, owner decision and five finite story moments.
+- `homepageStoryModel.ts` selects one scenario and step. The first view is a prepared result; selecting a scenario
+  resets to that view. Replay returns to the incoming need. Nothing accumulates, runs on a timer or calls a service.
+  Software proposals remain unpublished, customer responses remain unsent, and accounting inputs await review.
+- The layered agent, project and task surfaces are semantic buttons for those same story states. Their grid layout
+  gives text its own space at narrow widths and zoom. Scroll changes only perspective and lift. Its optional controller
+  unmounts offscreen, in a hidden document and for reduced motion. Direct controls remain immediate.
+- Hero, initial story, benefits, summaries and contact links are server-rendered. An error boundary contains failures
+  in the story. If client scripts or the enquiry handler are unavailable, the primary action keeps its native contact
+  anchor; the contact section links to the existing contact page.
+- `QualificationPopup` accepts an optional presentation. Without it, the original company form remains unchanged.
+  The homepage uses `subscribeToWaitlist`, the existing `qualification-popup` source, attribution and consent note.
+  It retains drafts on close/failure, validates locally, disables pending edits and fences duplicate submissions.
+  Success uses `/dekujeme?source=autonomous-agendas&lang=cs|en` without contact identity in the URL.
+- The full shared footer retains legal and funding information. Its optional claim and product links affect only
+  callers that supply them. Homepage metadata uses an `agenda` illustration and a page-specific content revision in
+  addition to the shared image version. Authored preview URLs and other pages' artwork are unchanged.
+
+## Preservation
+
+No changes to the company composition/content/metadata, whitepaper sources, root language selector, domain routing
+or deferred September PRD are needed. The legacy company redirect and canonical Czech-only offer remain in place.
+Rendered main text and Open Graph/X/canonical/alternate metadata are compared against the saved pre-change baseline
+for `/cs/pro-firmy`, `/cs/whitepaper` and `/en/whitepaper`. Shared-form preservation also has a browser submission test.
+
+## Verification
+
+Verification results and observed browser measurements are recorded here after the final checks. Browser test
+requests use the real local API with isolated in-memory contacts; failure/retry tests intercept their own requests.
+They do not prove production delivery, physical-device behavior or the availability of the illustrated integrations.

+                                        rectangle.right > task.left &&
+                                        rectangle.top < task.bottom &&

+++ b/.tmp/homepage-final-review.cjs
@@ -0,0 +1,91 @@
+const { chromium, expect } = require('@playwright/test');
+const fs = require('node:fs/promises');
+
+const BASE_URL = process.env.HOMEPAGE_REVIEW_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:4010';
+const OUTPUT = '.tmp/homepage-final-review';
+
+(async () => {
+    await fs.mkdir(OUTPUT, { recursive: true });
+    const browser = await chromium.launch();
+    const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 1000 }, hasTouch: true });
+    await context.addInitScript(() => {
+        localStorage.setItem('cookiesAccepted', 'true');
+        localStorage.setItem('cookiePreferences', JSON.stringify({ necessary: true, analytics: false, marketing: false }));
+        window.homepageReview = { layoutShift: 0, longTasks: [], largestContentfulPaint: 0 };
+        new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
+            for (const entry of list.getEntries()) if (!entry.hadRecentInput) window.homepageReview.layoutShift += entry.value;
+        }).observe({ type: 'layout-shift', buffered: true });
+        new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
+            window.homepageReview.longTasks.push(...list.getEntries().map((entry) => entry.duration));
+        }).observe({ type: 'longtask', buffered: true });
+        new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
+            window.homepageReview.largestContentfulPaint = list.getEntries().at(-1).startTime;
+        }).observe({ type: 'largest-contentful-paint', buffered: true });
+    });
+    const page = await context.newPage();
+    const results = {};
+    for (const language of ['cs', 'en']) {
+        await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1440, height: 1000 });
+        await page.goto(`${BASE_URL}/${language}`, { timeout: 180000 });
+        await expect(page.locator('.ah-scenario-picker button').first()).toBeEnabled();
+        await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
+        await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-desktop.png`, fullPage: true });
+        results[language] = { desktop: await page.evaluate(() => ({ ...window.homepageReview,
+            scriptBytes: performance.getEntriesByType('resource').filter((entry) => entry.initiatorType === 'script').reduce((sum, entry) => sum + entry.encodedBodySize, 0),
+            firstContentfulPaint: performance.getEntriesByName('first-contentful-paint')[0]?.startTime,
+        })) };
+        await page.locator('#agendas').scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+        await expect.poll(() => page.locator('.ah-story-panel').evaluate((element) => element.style.getPropertyValue('--ah-tilt'))).not.toBe('');
+        const before = await page.locator('.ah-scene-stack').evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).transform);
+        await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollBy({ top: 180, behavior: 'instant' }));
+        await expect.poll(() => page.locator('.ah-scene-stack').evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).transform)).not.toBe(before);
+        results[language].isScrollDepthChanged = true;
+        await page.setViewportSize({ width: 375, height: 812 });
+        await page.goto(`${BASE_URL}/${language}`);
+        await expect(page.locator('.ah-scenario-picker button').first()).toBeEnabled();
+        await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
+        await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-hero.png` });
+        results[language].phone = await page.evaluate(() => ({ ...window.homepageReview,
+            firstContentfulPaint: performance.getEntriesByName('first-contentful-paint')[0]?.startTime,
+        }));
+        const heights = [];
+        for (let scenario = 0; scenario < 3; scenario++) {
+            await page.locator('.ah-scenario-picker button').nth(scenario).tap();
+            await page.locator('.ah-scene').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-example-${scenario}.png` });
+            for (let step = 0; step < 5; step++) {
+                await page.locator('.ah-story-steps button').nth(step).tap();
+                heights.push(Math.round((await page.locator('.ah-experience').boundingBox()).height));
+            }
+        }
+        results[language].phoneStoryHeightRange = [Math.min(...heights), Math.max(...heights)];
+        await page.locator('#hero-cta').click();
+        await page.getByRole('dialog').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-form-top.png` });
+        await page.getByRole('dialog').getByRole('button', { name: language === 'cs' ? 'Odeslat a probrat nasazení' : 'Send enquiry and discuss deployment', exact: true }).scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+        await page.getByRole('dialog').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-form-bottom.png` });
+        await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
+        results[language].isFocusRestored = await page.locator('#hero-cta').evaluate((element) => document.activeElement === element);
+        await page.locator('footer').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-footer.png` });
+        for (const width of [320, 720, 900, 1024]) {
+            await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 900 });
+            expect(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth)).toBe(true);
+        }
+        const imageResponse = await context.request.get(`${BASE_URL}/${language}/opengraph-image?v=2&content=agendas-1`);
+        await fs.writeFile(`${OUTPUT}/${language}-social.png`, await imageResponse.body());
+    }
+    const cookieContext = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 375, height: 812 } });
+    const cookiePage = await cookieContext.newPage();
+    await cookiePage.goto(`${BASE_URL}/cs`);
+    await expect(cookiePage.locator('[data-cookie-consent-panel]')).toBeVisible();
+    await cookiePage.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/cs-cookie-hero.png` });
+    await cookiePage.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo({ top: document.body.scrollHeight, behavior: 'instant' }));
+    await cookiePage.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/cs-cookie-footer.png` });
+    const footer = await cookiePage.locator('footer').boundingBox();
+    const cookiePanel = await cookiePage.locator('[data-cookie-consent-panel]').boundingBox();
+    results.cookies = { isFooterClear: footer.y + footer.height <= cookiePanel.y, panelHeight: cookiePanel.height };
+    await cookiePage.locator('#hero-cta').click();
+    await expect(cookiePage.getByRole('dialog')).toBeVisible();
+    await cookiePage.getByRole('dialog').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/cs-cookie-form.png` });
+    await fs.writeFile(`${OUTPUT}/measurements.json`, JSON.stringify(results, null, 2));
+    console.log(JSON.stringify(results, null, 2));
+    await browser.close();
+})().catch((error) => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; });

diff --git a/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md b/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..b821f57938c5853034ac64c8b8007eb79fd73331
--- /dev/null
+++ b/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md
@@ -0,0 +1,49 @@
+# Autonomous agendas homepage
+
+The Czech `/cs` and English `/en` pages present ongoing business responsibilities and an enquiry about deployment.
+The shared composition lives in `businesses/homepage/HomepagePage.tsx`; Czech is the content source of truth.
+The September homepage proposal remains deferred and unchanged.
+
+## Analysis and implementation
+
+Before this change, both routes rendered `ProFirmyPage`, while their metadata already had its own module.
+The company offer owns its document Q&A proposition, shared qualification defaults and canonical `/cs/pro-firmy`
+address. The new homepage therefore has its own content and styles. The whitepaper's semantic controls and CSS
+perspective informed the presentation; none of its chapters, interactions or page styles were replaced.
+
+Whitepaper chapters 1 and 7 supply the shift to ongoing responsibility, chapter 11 supplies the three examples,
+and chapters 10 and 12 supply the approval boundaries and distinction between capabilities and vision. The page
+labels these as fictional illustrations of the direction being developed. It makes no measured customer-result,
+integration-availability, guaranteed-compliance or autonomous-payment claims.
+
+- `homepageScenarios.ts` supplies the interactive stories, readable native-disclosure summaries and enquiry choices.
+  Every scenario has a burden, entrusted responsibility, benefit, owner decision and five finite story moments.
+- `homepageStoryModel.ts` selects one scenario and step. The first view is a prepared result; selecting a scenario
+  resets to that view. Replay returns to the incoming need. Nothing accumulates, runs on a timer or calls a service.
+  Software proposals remain unpublished, customer responses remain unsent, and accounting inputs await review.
+- The layered agent, project and task surfaces are semantic buttons for those same story states. Their grid layout
+  gives text its own space at narrow widths and zoom. Scroll changes only perspective and lift. Its optional controller
+  unmounts offscreen, in a hidden document and for reduced motion. Direct controls remain immediate.
+- Hero, initial story, benefits, summaries and contact links are server-rendered. An error boundary contains failures
+  in the story. If client scripts or the enquiry handler are unavailable, the primary action keeps its native contact
+  anchor; the contact section links to the existing contact page.
+- `QualificationPopup` accepts an optional presentation. Without it, the original company form remains unchanged.
+  The homepage uses `subscribeToWaitlist`, the existing `qualification-popup` source, attribution and consent note.
+  It retains drafts on close/failure, validates locally, disables pending edits and fences duplicate submissions.
+  Success uses `/dekujeme?source=autonomous-agendas&lang=cs|en` without contact identity in the URL.
+- The full shared footer retains legal and funding information. Its optional claim and product links affect only
+  callers that supply them. Homepage metadata uses an `agenda` illustration and a page-specific content revision in
+  addition to the shared image version. Authored preview URLs and other pages' artwork are unchanged.
+
+## Preservation
+
+No changes to the company composition/content/metadata, whitepaper sources, root language selector, domain routing
+or deferred September PRD are needed. The legacy company redirect and canonical Czech-only offer remain in place.
+Rendered main text and Open Graph/X/canonical/alternate metadata are compared against the saved pre-change baseline
+for `/cs/pro-firmy`, `/cs/whitepaper` and `/en/whitepaper`. Shared-form preservation also has a browser submission test.
+
+## Verification
+
+Verification results and observed browser measurements are recorded here after the final checks. Browser test
+requests use the real local API with isolated in-memory contacts; failure/retry tests intercept their own requests.
+They do not prove production delivery, physical-device behavior or the availability of the illustrated integrations.

@@ -0,0 +1,91 @@
+const { chromium, expect } = require('@playwright/test');
+const fs = require('node:fs/promises');
+
+const BASE_URL = process.env.HOMEPAGE_REVIEW_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:4010';
+const OUTPUT = '.tmp/homepage-final-review';
+
+(async () => {
+    await fs.mkdir(OUTPUT, { recursive: true });
+    const browser = await chromium.launch();
+    const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 1000 }, hasTouch: true });
+    await context.addInitScript(() => {
+        localStorage.setItem('cookiesAccepted', 'true');
+        localStorage.setItem('cookiePreferences', JSON.stringify({ necessary: true, analytics: false, marketing: false }));
+        window.homepageReview = { layoutShift: 0, longTasks: [], largestContentfulPaint: 0 };
+        new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
+            for (const entry of list.getEntries()) if (!entry.hadRecentInput) window.homepageReview.layoutShift += entry.value;
+        }).observe({ type: 'layout-shift', buffered: true });
+        new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
+            window.homepageReview.longTasks.push(...list.getEntries().map((entry) => entry.duration));
+        }).observe({ type: 'longtask', buffered: true });
+        new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
+            window.homepageReview.largestContentfulPaint = list.getEntries().at(-1).startTime;
+        }).observe({ type: 'largest-contentful-paint', buffered: true });
+    });
+    const page = await context.newPage();
+    const results = {};
+    for (const language of ['cs', 'en']) {
+        await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1440, height: 1000 });
+        await page.goto(`${BASE_URL}/${language}`, { timeout: 180000 });
+        await expect(page.locator('.ah-scenario-picker button').first()).toBeEnabled();
+        await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
+        await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-desktop.png`, fullPage: true });
+        results[language] = { desktop: await page.evaluate(() => ({ ...window.homepageReview,
+            scriptBytes: performance.getEntriesByType('resource').filter((entry) => entry.initiatorType === 'script').reduce((sum, entry) => sum + entry.encodedBodySize, 0),
+            firstContentfulPaint: performance.getEntriesByName('first-contentful-paint')[0]?.startTime,
+        })) };
+        await page.locator('#agendas').scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+        await expect.poll(() => page.locator('.ah-story-panel').evaluate((element) => element.style.getPropertyValue('--ah-tilt'))).not.toBe('');
+        const before = await page.locator('.ah-scene-stack').evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).transform);
+        await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollBy({ top: 180, behavior: 'instant' }));
+        await expect.poll(() => page.locator('.ah-scene-stack').evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).transform)).not.toBe(before);
+        results[language].isScrollDepthChanged = true;
+        await page.setViewportSize({ width: 375, height: 812 });
+        await page.goto(`${BASE_URL}/${language}`);
+        await expect(page.locator('.ah-scenario-picker button').first()).toBeEnabled();
+        await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
+        await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-hero.png` });
+        results[language].phone = await page.evaluate(() => ({ ...window.homepageReview,
+            firstContentfulPaint: performance.getEntriesByName('first-contentful-paint')[0]?.startTime,
+        }));
+        const heights = [];
+        for (let scenario = 0; scenario < 3; scenario++) {
+            await page.locator('.ah-scenario-picker button').nth(scenario).tap();
+            await page.locator('.ah-scene').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-example-${scenario}.png` });
+            for (let step = 0; step < 5; step++) {
+                await page.locator('.ah-story-steps button').nth(step).tap();
+                heights.push(Math.round((await page.locator('.ah-experience').boundingBox()).height));
+            }
+        }
+        results[language].phoneStoryHeightRange = [Math.min(...heights), Math.max(...heights)];
+        await page.locator('#hero-cta').click();
+        await page.getByRole('dialog').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-form-top.png` });
+        await page.getByRole('dialog').getByRole('button', { name: language === 'cs' ? 'Odeslat a probrat nasazení' : 'Send enquiry and discuss deployment', exact: true }).scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+        await page.getByRole('dialog').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-form-bottom.png` });
+        await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
+        results[language].isFocusRestored = await page.locator('#hero-cta').evaluate((element) => document.activeElement === element);
+        await page.locator('footer').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-footer.png` });
+        for (const width of [320, 720, 900, 1024]) {
+            await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 900 });
+            expect(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth)).toBe(true);
+        }
+        const imageResponse = await context.request.get(`${BASE_URL}/${language}/opengraph-image?v=2&content=agendas-1`);
+        await fs.writeFile(`${OUTPUT}/${language}-social.png`, await imageResponse.body());
+    }
+    const cookieContext = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 375, height: 812 } });
+    const cookiePage = await cookieContext.newPage();
+    await cookiePage.goto(`${BASE_URL}/cs`);
+    await expect(cookiePage.locator('[data-cookie-consent-panel]')).toBeVisible();
+    await cookiePage.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/cs-cookie-hero.png` });
+    await cookiePage.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo({ top: document.body.scrollHeight, behavior: 'instant' }));
+    await cookiePage.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/cs-cookie-footer.png` });
+    const footer = await cookiePage.locator('footer').boundingBox();
+    const cookiePanel = await cookiePage.locator('[data-cookie-consent-panel]').boundingBox();
+    results.cookies = { isFooterClear: footer.y + footer.height <= cookiePanel.y, panelHeight: cookiePanel.height };
+    await cookiePage.locator('#hero-cta').click();
+    await expect(cookiePage.getByRole('dialog')).toBeVisible();
+    await cookiePage.getByRole('dialog').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/cs-cookie-form.png` });
+    await fs.writeFile(`${OUTPUT}/measurements.json`, JSON.stringify(results, null, 2));
+    console.log(JSON.stringify(results, null, 2));
+    await browser.close();
+})().catch((error) => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; });
