import 'dotenv/config';
import { defineConfig } from '@playwright/test';

/**
 * How long a cold Next.js start or one E2E test may take, compilation included
 *
 * Note: This is the shared cold-start budget for the server and every E2E test, so neither a slow first server
 *       readiness check nor a route reached first can be reported as broken merely for having been compiled.
 */
const E2E_COLD_COMPILATION_TEST_TIMEOUT_MS = 180_000;

/**
 * A browser assertion can be the first request for a lazily loaded client-side editor. Keep its cold compilation
 * allowance next to the suite-wide test allowance instead of making individual tests depend on implementation timing.
 */
const E2E_COLD_COMPONENT_EXPECT_TIMEOUT_MS = 60_000;

// This suite retains every lazily compiled route to avoid re-emitting shared chunks under an active request.
// Its complete compiler graph needs more heap than Next's ordinary development-session default (half of RAM).
// Set the budget only on the owned E2E server, and honor an explicit owner-supplied Node heap limit.
const E2E_DEVELOPMENT_SERVER_HEAP_SIZE_MIB = 10_240;
const E2E_INHERITED_NODE_OPTIONS = process.env.NODE_OPTIONS ?? '';
const IS_E2E_SERVER_HEAP_LIMIT_CONFIGURED = /(?:^|[\s"'])--max[-_]old[-_]space[-_]size(?:[-_]percentage)?(?:[=\s"']|$)/.test(
    E2E_INHERITED_NODE_OPTIONS,
);
const E2E_DEVELOPMENT_SERVER_NODE_OPTIONS = IS_E2E_SERVER_HEAP_LIMIT_CONFIGURED
    ? E2E_INHERITED_NODE_OPTIONS
    : `${E2E_INHERITED_NODE_OPTIONS} --max-old-space-size=${E2E_DEVELOPMENT_SERVER_HEAP_SIZE_MIB}`.trim();

const baseURL = process.env.E2E_BASE_URL ?? 'http://127.0.0.1:4009';
const usesExternalServer = process.env.E2E_BASE_URL !== undefined;
const usesIsolatedInMemorySupabase = !process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY?.trim();

export default defineConfig({
    testDir: './tests/e2e',
    outputDir: './tests/e2e/.artifacts',
    fullyParallel: false,
    workers: 1,
    // A cold development server or the configured external database can fail transiently. Retry the whole test in
    // a fresh browser context once; keep its assertions and failed-attempt trace, and still fail persistent errors.
    retries: 1,
    // The Next.js development server compiles a page or an API endpoint the first time a test reaches it, so the first
    // test which visits a page or submits into an endpoint pays for that compilation on top of its own work. The
    // budget of one test is therefore that compilation headroom rather than the time its assertions need.
    timeout: E2E_COLD_COMPILATION_TEST_TIMEOUT_MS,
    expect: {
        timeout: E2E_COLD_COMPONENT_EXPECT_TIMEOUT_MS,
    },
    reporter: 'list',
    globalTeardown: './tests/e2e/globalTeardown.ts',
    use: {
        baseURL,
        // Allows the same real recording/storage suite to verify an installed browser, e.g. msedge.
        channel: process.env.E2E_BROWSER_CHANNEL || undefined,
        viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 },
        video: { mode: 'on', size: { width: 1280, height: 720 } },
        screenshot: 'only-on-failure',
        trace: 'retain-on-failure',
    },
    webServer: usesExternalServer
        ? undefined
        : {
              // Next normally enables Node's source-map cache as well as the browser's development maps. Keeping
              // every compiled route adds avoidable memory in that server cache. Together with the explicit heap
              // budget below, the supported flag omits only Node's --enable-source-maps;
              // browser source maps, failed-attempt traces and the complete development-server suite stay available.
              command: 'npx next dev --disable-source-maps -p 4009',
              url: baseURL,
              reuseExistingServer: !process.env.CI,
              timeout: E2E_COLD_COMPILATION_TEST_TIMEOUT_MS,
              // The test server exercises the public API without running or repairing
              // migrations as a side effect.
              // Without a service role key, the same endpoints use an isolated in-memory
              // store so local verification does not depend on a private credential.
              // It also keeps every route it compiled for the whole run, so that a route
              // is never disposed and rebuilt underneath a later test.
              // Next does not replace explicitly empty environment values from .env.
              env: {
                  ...process.env,
                  NODE_OPTIONS: E2E_DEVELOPMENT_SERVER_NODE_OPTIONS,
                  DATABASE_URL: '',
                  E2E_IN_MEMORY_SUPABASE: usesIsolatedInMemorySupabase ? 'true' : '',
                  E2E_KEEP_COMPILED_ROUTES: 'true',
              },
          },
});

import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test';
import { HOMEPAGE_CONTENT } from '../../businesses/homepage/homepageContent';
import { HOMEPAGE_SCENARIOS } from '../../businesses/homepage/homepageScenarios';
import { getHomepageEnquiry, getHomepageEnquiryThanks } from '../../businesses/homepage/homepageEnquiry';
import { createE2eTestEmail } from '../../lib/e2e/testData';
import { submitAndExpectApiSuccess } from './support/submissions';

test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
    await page.addInitScript(() => {
        localStorage.setItem('cookiesAccepted', 'true');
        localStorage.setItem(
            'cookiePreferences',
            JSON.stringify({ necessary: true, analytics: false, marketing: false }),
        );
    });
});

for (const language of ['cs', 'en'] as const) {
    const CONTENT = HOMEPAGE_CONTENT[language];
    const SCENARIOS = HOMEPAGE_SCENARIOS[language];
    const ENQUIRY = getHomepageEnquiry(language);

    test(`keeps selection, all story states, rapid switching and replay coherent without business requests (${language})`, async ({
        page,
    }) => {
        const errors: string[] = [];
        const businessRequests: string[] = [];
        page.on('pageerror', (error) => errors.push(error.message));
        page.on('request', (request) => {
            if (
                !['GET', 'HEAD'].includes(request.method()) ||
                new URL(request.url()).pathname.startsWith('/api/') ||
                /openai|dashscope|anthropic/.test(request.url())
            )
                businessRequests.push(request.url());
        });
        await page.goto(`/${language}`);
        await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1 })).toHaveText(CONTENT.title.join(''));
        const story = page.getByTestId('homepage-story');
        const picker = page.getByRole('group', { name: CONTENT.story.choose });
        await expect(story).toHaveAttribute('data-step', '1');
        for (const scenario of SCENARIOS) {
            const selection = picker.getByRole('button', { name: new RegExp(scenario.name) });
            await selection.click();
            await expect(selection).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
            await expect(story).toHaveAttribute('data-step', '1');
            await story.getByRole('button', { name: CONTENT.story.replay }).click();
            for (const [index, step] of Array.from(scenario.steps.entries())) {
                await expect(story).toHaveAttribute('data-step', String(index));
                await expect(story.getByRole('heading', { name: step.title, exact: true })).toBeVisible();
                await expect(story.locator('.ah-project')).toContainText(step.artifactDetail);
                await expect(story.locator('.ah-step-result')).toContainText(step.result);
                if (index < scenario.steps.length - 1)
                    await story.getByRole('button', { name: CONTENT.story.next, exact: true }).click();
            }
            await expect(story.getByRole('button', { name: CONTENT.story.next, exact: true })).toBeDisabled();
            await story.getByRole('button', { name: CONTENT.story.previous }).click();
            await expect(story).toHaveAttribute('data-step', '3');
        }
        // Dispatch in the same browser turn, without waiting for any animation or a network round trip.
        await picker.locator('button').evaluateAll((buttons) => {
            for (let index = 0; index < 24; index++) (buttons[index % buttons.length] as HTMLButtonElement).click();
            (buttons[0] as HTMLButtonElement).click();
        });
        await expect(story).toHaveAttribute('data-scenario', 'software');
        await expect(story).toHaveAttribute('data-step', '1');
        await expect(story.locator('.ah-project')).toHaveCount(1);
        await expect(story.locator('.ah-task')).toHaveCount(1);
        await expect(story.getByRole('heading', { name: SCENARIOS[0].steps[1].title, exact: true })).toBeVisible();
        expect(businessRequests).toEqual([]);
        expect(errors).toEqual([]);
    });

    test(`enquiry validates, preserves drafts on close/failure, fences pending requests and succeeds (${language})`, async ({
        page,
    }) => {
        let attempts = 0;
        let releaseResponse!: () => void;
        const pendingResponse = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
            releaseResponse = resolve;
        });
        const submissions: Record<string, string>[] = [];
        await page.route('**/api/waitlist', async (route) => {
            attempts++;
            submissions.push(route.request().postDataJSON());
            if (attempts === 1) {
                await pendingResponse;
                await route.fulfill({ status: 503, json: { error: 'Unavailable' } });
            } else await route.fulfill({ json: { success: true } });
        });
        await page.goto(`/${language}`);
        await page.locator('#hero-cta').click();
        const dialog = page.getByRole('dialog');
        await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: ENQUIRY.submit, exact: true }).click();
        await expect(dialog.getByText(ENQUIRY.requiredError).first()).toBeVisible();
        expect(attempts).toBe(0);
        await dialog.getByLabel(ENQUIRY.agendaLabel).selectOption(SCENARIOS[1].name);
        await dialog.getByLabel(ENQUIRY.messageLabel).fill('Repeated work needs consistent follow-through.');
        for (const field of ENQUIRY.fields) {
            if (field.id !== 'phone')
                await dialog
                    .getByLabel(field.label, { exact: true })
                    .fill(field.id === 'email' ? 'invalid' : `Example ${field.id}`);
        }
        await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: ENQUIRY.submit, exact: true }).click();
        await expect(dialog.getByText(ENQUIRY.emailError)).toBeVisible();
        const emailLabel = ENQUIRY.fields.find((field) => field.id === 'email')!.label;
        await dialog.getByLabel(emailLabel, { exact: true }).fill('homepage@example.com');
        await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
        await expect(dialog).not.toBeVisible();
        await expect(page.locator('#hero-cta')).toBeFocused();
        const story = page.getByTestId('homepage-story');
        await expect(story).toHaveAttribute('data-step', '1');
        await page
            .getByRole('group', { name: CONTENT.story.choose })
            .getByRole('button', { name: new RegExp(SCENARIOS[2].name) })
            .click();
        await story.getByRole('link', { name: CONTENT.cta }).click();
        await expect(dialog.getByLabel(ENQUIRY.messageLabel)).toHaveValue(
            'Repeated work needs consistent follow-through.',
        );
        await expect(dialog.getByLabel(ENQUIRY.agendaLabel)).toHaveValue(SCENARIOS[1].name);
        await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: ENQUIRY.submit, exact: true }).click();
        await expect(dialog.getByRole('button', { name: ENQUIRY.submitting, exact: true })).toBeDisabled();
        await expect(dialog.getByLabel(emailLabel, { exact: true })).toBeDisabled();

diff --git a/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md b/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..b821f57938c5853034ac64c8b8007eb79fd73331
--- /dev/null
+++ b/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md
@@ -0,0 +1,49 @@
+# Autonomous agendas homepage
+
+The Czech `/cs` and English `/en` pages present ongoing business responsibilities and an enquiry about deployment.
+The shared composition lives in `businesses/homepage/HomepagePage.tsx`; Czech is the content source of truth.
+The September homepage proposal remains deferred and unchanged.
+
+## Analysis and implementation
+
+Before this change, both routes rendered `ProFirmyPage`, while their metadata already had its own module.
+The company offer owns its document Q&A proposition, shared qualification defaults and canonical `/cs/pro-firmy`
+address. The new homepage therefore has its own content and styles. The whitepaper's semantic controls and CSS
+perspective informed the presentation; none of its chapters, interactions or page styles were replaced.
+
+Whitepaper chapters 1 and 7 supply the shift to ongoing responsibility, chapter 11 supplies the three examples,
+and chapters 10 and 12 supply the approval boundaries and distinction between capabilities and vision. The page
+labels these as fictional illustrations of the direction being developed. It makes no measured customer-result,
+integration-availability, guaranteed-compliance or autonomous-payment claims.
+
+- `homepageScenarios.ts` supplies the interactive stories, readable native-disclosure summaries and enquiry choices.
+  Every scenario has a burden, entrusted responsibility, benefit, owner decision and five finite story moments.
+- `homepageStoryModel.ts` selects one scenario and step. The first view is a prepared result; selecting a scenario
+  resets to that view. Replay returns to the incoming need. Nothing accumulates, runs on a timer or calls a service.
+  Software proposals remain unpublished, customer responses remain unsent, and accounting inputs await review.
+- The layered agent, project and task surfaces are semantic buttons for those same story states. Their grid layout
+  gives text its own space at narrow widths and zoom. Scroll changes only perspective and lift. Its optional controller
+  unmounts offscreen, in a hidden document and for reduced motion. Direct controls remain immediate.
+- Hero, initial story, benefits, summaries and contact links are server-rendered. An error boundary contains failures
+  in the story. If client scripts or the enquiry handler are unavailable, the primary action keeps its native contact
+  anchor; the contact section links to the existing contact page.
+- `QualificationPopup` accepts an optional presentation. Without it, the original company form remains unchanged.
+  The homepage uses `subscribeToWaitlist`, the existing `qualification-popup` source, attribution and consent note.
+  It retains drafts on close/failure, validates locally, disables pending edits and fences duplicate submissions.
+  Success uses `/dekujeme?source=autonomous-agendas&lang=cs|en` without contact identity in the URL.
+- The full shared footer retains legal and funding information. Its optional claim and product links affect only
+  callers that supply them. Homepage metadata uses an `agenda` illustration and a page-specific content revision in
+  addition to the shared image version. Authored preview URLs and other pages' artwork are unchanged.
+
+## Preservation
+
+No changes to the company composition/content/metadata, whitepaper sources, root language selector, domain routing
+or deferred September PRD are needed. The legacy company redirect and canonical Czech-only offer remain in place.
+Rendered main text and Open Graph/X/canonical/alternate metadata are compared against the saved pre-change baseline
+for `/cs/pro-firmy`, `/cs/whitepaper` and `/en/whitepaper`. Shared-form preservation also has a browser submission test.
+
+## Verification
+
+Verification results and observed browser measurements are recorded here after the final checks. Browser test
+requests use the real local API with isolated in-memory contacts; failure/retry tests intercept their own requests.
+They do not prove production delivery, physical-device behavior or the availability of the illustrated integrations.

@@ -0,0 +1,99 @@
+const { chromium, expect: baseExpect } = require('@playwright/test');
+const expect = baseExpect.configure({ timeout: 60000 });
+const fs = require('node:fs/promises');
+
+const BASE_URL = process.env.HOMEPAGE_REVIEW_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:4010';
+const OUTPUT = '.tmp/homepage-final-review';
+let browser;
+
+(async () => {
+    await fs.mkdir(OUTPUT, { recursive: true });
+    browser = await chromium.launch();
+    const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 1000 }, hasTouch: true });
+    await context.addInitScript(() => {
+        localStorage.setItem('cookiesAccepted', 'true');
+        localStorage.setItem('cookiePreferences', JSON.stringify({ necessary: true, analytics: false, marketing: false }));
+        window.homepageReview = { layoutShift: 0, longTasks: [], largestContentfulPaint: 0 };
+        new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
+            for (const entry of list.getEntries()) if (!entry.hadRecentInput) window.homepageReview.layoutShift += entry.value;
+        }).observe({ type: 'layout-shift', buffered: true });
+        new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
+            window.homepageReview.longTasks.push(...list.getEntries().map((entry) => entry.duration));
+        }).observe({ type: 'longtask', buffered: true });
+        new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
+            window.homepageReview.largestContentfulPaint = list.getEntries().at(-1).startTime;
+        }).observe({ type: 'largest-contentful-paint', buffered: true });
+    });
+    const page = await context.newPage();
+    page.on('pageerror', (error) => console.error('Browser error:', error.message));
+    const results = {};
+    for (const language of ['cs', 'en']) {
+        await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1440, height: 1000 });
+        await page.goto(`${BASE_URL}/${language}`, { timeout: 180000 });
+        await expect(page.locator('.ah-scenario-picker button').first()).toBeEnabled();
+        await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
+        await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-desktop.png`, fullPage: true });
+        results[language] = { desktop: await page.evaluate(() => ({ ...window.homepageReview,
+            scriptBytes: performance.getEntriesByType('resource').filter((entry) => entry.initiatorType === 'script').reduce((sum, entry) => sum + entry.encodedBodySize, 0),
+            firstContentfulPaint: performance.getEntriesByName('first-contentful-paint')[0]?.startTime,
+        })) };
+        await page.locator('#agendas').scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+        await expect.poll(() => page.locator('.ah-story-panel').evaluate((element) => element.style.getPropertyValue('--ah-tilt'))).not.toBe('');
+        const before = await page.locator('.ah-scene-stack').evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).transform);
+        await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollBy({ top: 180, behavior: 'instant' }));
+        await expect.poll(() => page.locator('.ah-scene-stack').evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).transform)).not.toBe(before);
+        results[language].isScrollDepthChanged = true;
+        await page.setViewportSize({ width: 375, height: 812 });
+        await page.goto(`${BASE_URL}/${language}`);
+        await expect(page.locator('.ah-scenario-picker button').first()).toBeEnabled();
+        await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
+        await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-hero.png` });
+        results[language].phone = await page.evaluate(() => ({ ...window.homepageReview,
+            firstContentfulPaint: performance.getEntriesByName('first-contentful-paint')[0]?.startTime,
+        }));
+        const heights = [];
+        for (let scenario = 0; scenario < 3; scenario++) {
+            await page.locator('.ah-scenario-picker button').nth(scenario).tap();
+            await page.locator('.ah-scene').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-example-${scenario}.png` });
+            for (let step = 0; step < 5; step++) {
+                await page.locator('.ah-story-steps button').nth(step).tap();
+                heights.push(Math.round((await page.locator('.ah-experience').boundingBox()).height));
+            }
+        }
+        results[language].phoneStoryHeightRange = [Math.min(...heights), Math.max(...heights)];
+        await page.locator('#hero-cta').click();
+        await page.getByRole('dialog').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-form-top.png` });
+        await page.getByRole('dialog').locator('form > p').last().scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+        await page.getByRole('dialog').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-form-bottom.png` });
+        await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
+        await expect(page.getByRole('dialog')).not.toBeVisible();
+        await expect(page.locator('#hero-cta')).toBeFocused();
+        results[language].isFocusRestored = await page.locator('#hero-cta').evaluate((element) => document.activeElement === element);
+        await page.locator('footer').scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+        await page.locator('footer img').evaluateAll((images) => Promise.all(images.map((image) => image.decode())));
+        await page.locator('footer').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-footer.png` });
+        for (const width of [320, 720, 900, 1024]) {
+            await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 900 });
+            expect(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth)).toBe(true);
+        }
+        const imageResponse = await context.request.get(`${BASE_URL}/${language}/opengraph-image?v=2&content=agendas-1`);
+        await fs.writeFile(`${OUTPUT}/${language}-social.png`, await imageResponse.body());
+    }
+    const cookieContext = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 375, height: 812 } });
+    const cookiePage = await cookieContext.newPage();
+    await cookiePage.goto(`${BASE_URL}/cs`);
+    await expect(cookiePage.locator('[data-cookie-consent-panel]')).toBeVisible();
+    await cookiePage.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/cs-cookie-hero.png` });
+    await cookiePage.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo({ top: document.body.scrollHeight, behavior: 'instant' }));
+    await cookiePage.locator('footer img').evaluateAll((images) => Promise.all(images.map((image) => image.decode())));
+    await cookiePage.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/cs-cookie-footer.png` });
+    const footer = await cookiePage.locator('footer').boundingBox();
+    const cookiePanel = await cookiePage.locator('[data-cookie-consent-panel]').boundingBox();
+    results.cookies = { isFooterClear: footer.y + footer.height <= cookiePanel.y, panelHeight: cookiePanel.height };
+    await cookiePage.locator('#hero-cta').click();
+    await expect(cookiePage.getByRole('dialog')).toBeVisible();
+    await cookiePage.getByRole('dialog').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/cs-cookie-form.png` });
+    await fs.writeFile(`${OUTPUT}/measurements.json`, JSON.stringify(results, null, 2));
+    console.log(JSON.stringify(results, null, 2));
+    await browser.close();
+})().catch(async (error) => { console.error(error); await browser?.close(); process.exitCode = 1; });

   concrete benefits and an enquiry about deployment. Their three fictional stories (software care, customer
   communication and accounting inputs) share localized definitions with the server-rendered summaries. One finite
   state model owns scenario/step selection; direct controls never execute work, and scroll changes only visual depth.
+  Layered surfaces keep their own readable space at narrow widths; contact anchors remain usable before the enquiry handler is ready.
   Optional motion stops offscreen, in hidden tabs and for reduced motion. Drafts, approval, continuation and waiting
   remain distinct. The configured qualification presentation retains drafts, uses the existing contact source and
   consent infrastructure, and reaches a localized `/dekujeme?source=autonomous-agendas&lang=…` confirmation.

diff --git a/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md b/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..b821f57938c5853034ac64c8b8007eb79fd73331
--- /dev/null
+++ b/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md
@@ -0,0 +1,49 @@
+# Autonomous agendas homepage
+
+The Czech `/cs` and English `/en` pages present ongoing business responsibilities and an enquiry about deployment.
+The shared composition lives in `businesses/homepage/HomepagePage.tsx`; Czech is the content source of truth.
+The September homepage proposal remains deferred and unchanged.
+
+## Analysis and implementation
+
+Before this change, both routes rendered `ProFirmyPage`, while their metadata already had its own module.
+The company offer owns its document Q&A proposition, shared qualification defaults and canonical `/cs/pro-firmy`
+address. The new homepage therefore has its own content and styles. The whitepaper's semantic controls and CSS
+perspective informed the presentation; none of its chapters, interactions or page styles were replaced.
+
+Whitepaper chapters 1 and 7 supply the shift to ongoing responsibility, chapter 11 supplies the three examples,
+and chapters 10 and 12 supply the approval boundaries and distinction between capabilities and vision. The page
+labels these as fictional illustrations of the direction being developed. It makes no measured customer-result,
+integration-availability, guaranteed-compliance or autonomous-payment claims.
+
+- `homepageScenarios.ts` supplies the interactive stories, readable native-disclosure summaries and enquiry choices.
+  Every scenario has a burden, entrusted responsibility, benefit, owner decision and five finite story moments.
+- `homepageStoryModel.ts` selects one scenario and step. The first view is a prepared result; selecting a scenario
+  resets to that view. Replay returns to the incoming need. Nothing accumulates, runs on a timer or calls a service.
+  Software proposals remain unpublished, customer responses remain unsent, and accounting inputs await review.
+- The layered agent, project and task surfaces are semantic buttons for those same story states. Their grid layout
+  gives text its own space at narrow widths and zoom. Scroll changes only perspective and lift. Its optional controller
+  unmounts offscreen, in a hidden document and for reduced motion. Direct controls remain immediate.
+- Hero, initial story, benefits, summaries and contact links are server-rendered. An error boundary contains failures
+  in the story. If client scripts or the enquiry handler are unavailable, the primary action keeps its native contact
+  anchor; the contact section links to the existing contact page.
+- `QualificationPopup` accepts an optional presentation. Without it, the original company form remains unchanged.
+  The homepage uses `subscribeToWaitlist`, the existing `qualification-popup` source, attribution and consent note.
+  It retains drafts on close/failure, validates locally, disables pending edits and fences duplicate submissions.
+  Success uses `/dekujeme?source=autonomous-agendas&lang=cs|en` without contact identity in the URL.
+- The full shared footer retains legal and funding information. Its optional claim and product links affect only
+  callers that supply them. Homepage metadata uses an `agenda` illustration and a page-specific content revision in
+  addition to the shared image version. Authored preview URLs and other pages' artwork are unchanged.
+
+## Preservation
+
+No changes to the company composition/content/metadata, whitepaper sources, root language selector, domain routing
+or deferred September PRD are needed. The legacy company redirect and canonical Czech-only offer remain in place.
+Rendered main text and Open Graph/X/canonical/alternate metadata are compared against the saved pre-change baseline
+for `/cs/pro-firmy`, `/cs/whitepaper` and `/en/whitepaper`. Shared-form preservation also has a browser submission test.
+
+## Verification
+
+Verification results and observed browser measurements are recorded here after the final checks. Browser test
+requests use the real local API with isolated in-memory contacts; failure/retry tests intercept their own requests.
+They do not prove production delivery, physical-device behavior or the availability of the illustrated integrations.

+                            const task = element.querySelector('.ah-task')!.getBoundingClientRect();

+                                element.querySelectorAll(
+                                    '.ah-artifact-detail, .ah-artifact-title, .ah-message, .ah-mini-form, .ah-document-list',
+                                ),
+                            ).flatMap((artifact) => {
+                                const range = document.createRange();
+                                range.selectNodeContents(artifact);
+                                const isCovered = Array.from(range.getClientRects()).some(
+                                    (rectangle) =>
+                                        rectangle.left < task.right &&
+                                        rectangle.right > task.left &&
+                                        rectangle.top < task.bottom &&
+                                        rectangle.bottom > task.top,
+                                );
+                                return isCovered ? [artifact.textContent] : [];
+                            });
+                        });

+        for (let scenario = 0; scenario < 3; scenario++) {

+            for (let step = 0; step < 5; step++) {
+                await page.locator('.ah-story-steps button').nth(step).tap();
+                heights.push(Math.round((await page.locator('.ah-experience').boundingBox()).height));
+            }
+        }
+        results[language].phoneStoryHeightRange = [Math.min(...heights), Math.max(...heights)];
+        await page.locator('#hero-cta').click();
+        await page.getByRole('dialog').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-form-top.png` });
+        await page.getByRole('dialog').locator('form > p').last().scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+        await page.getByRole('dialog').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-form-bottom.png` });
+        await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
+        await expect(page.getByRole('dialog')).not.toBeVisible();
+        await expect(page.locator('#hero-cta')).toBeFocused();
+        results[language].isFocusRestored = await page.locator('#hero-cta').evaluate((element) => document.activeElement === element);
+        await page.locator('footer').scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+        await page.locator('footer img').evaluateAll((images) => Promise.all(images.map((image) => image.decode())));
+        await page.locator('footer').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-footer.png` });
+        for (const width of [320, 720, 900, 1024]) {
+            await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 900 });
+            expect(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth)).toBe(true);
+        }
+        const imageResponse = await context.request.get(`${BASE_URL}/${language}/opengraph-image?v=2&content=agendas-1`);
+        await fs.writeFile(`${OUTPUT}/${language}-social.png`, await imageResponse.body());
+    }
+    const cookieContext = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 375, height: 812 } });
+    const cookiePage = await cookieContext.newPage();
+    await cookiePage.goto(`${BASE_URL}/cs`);
+    await expect(cookiePage.locator('[data-cookie-consent-panel]')).toBeVisible();
+    await cookiePage.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/cs-cookie-hero.png` });
+    await cookiePage.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo({ top: document.body.scrollHeight, behavior: 'instant' }));
+    await cookiePage.locator('footer img').evaluateAll((images) => Promise.all(images.map((image) => image.decode())));
+    await cookiePage.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/cs-cookie-footer.png` });
+    const footer = await cookiePage.locator('footer').boundingBox();
+    const cookiePanel = await cookiePage.locator('[data-cookie-consent-panel]').boundingBox();
+    results.cookies = { isFooterClear: footer.y + footer.height <= cookiePanel.y, panelHeight: cookiePanel.height };
+    await cookiePage.locator('#hero-cta').click();
+    await expect(cookiePage.getByRole('dialog')).toBeVisible();
+    await cookiePage.getByRole('dialog').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/cs-cookie-form.png` });
+    await fs.writeFile(`${OUTPUT}/measurements.json`, JSON.stringify(results, null, 2));
+    console.log(JSON.stringify(results, null, 2));
+    await browser.close();
+})().catch(async (error) => { console.error(error); await browser?.close(); process.exitCode = 1; });

diff --git a/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md b/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..b821f57938c5853034ac64c8b8007eb79fd73331
--- /dev/null
+++ b/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md
@@ -0,0 +1,49 @@
+# Autonomous agendas homepage
+
+The Czech `/cs` and English `/en` pages present ongoing business responsibilities and an enquiry about deployment.
+The shared composition lives in `businesses/homepage/HomepagePage.tsx`; Czech is the content source of truth.
+The September homepage proposal remains deferred and unchanged.
+
+## Analysis and implementation
+
+Before this change, both routes rendered `ProFirmyPage`, while their metadata already had its own module.
+The company offer owns its document Q&A proposition, shared qualification defaults and canonical `/cs/pro-firmy`
+address. The new homepage therefore has its own content and styles. The whitepaper's semantic controls and CSS
+perspective informed the presentation; none of its chapters, interactions or page styles were replaced.
+
+Whitepaper chapters 1 and 7 supply the shift to ongoing responsibility, chapter 11 supplies the three examples,
+and chapters 10 and 12 supply the approval boundaries and distinction between capabilities and vision. The page
+labels these as fictional illustrations of the direction being developed. It makes no measured customer-result,
+integration-availability, guaranteed-compliance or autonomous-payment claims.
+
+- `homepageScenarios.ts` supplies the interactive stories, readable native-disclosure summaries and enquiry choices.
+  Every scenario has a burden, entrusted responsibility, benefit, owner decision and five finite story moments.
+- `homepageStoryModel.ts` selects one scenario and step. The first view is a prepared result; selecting a scenario
+  resets to that view. Replay returns to the incoming need. Nothing accumulates, runs on a timer or calls a service.
+  Software proposals remain unpublished, customer responses remain unsent, and accounting inputs await review.
+- The layered agent, project and task surfaces are semantic buttons for those same story states. Their grid layout
+  gives text its own space at narrow widths and zoom. Scroll changes only perspective and lift. Its optional controller
+  unmounts offscreen, in a hidden document and for reduced motion. Direct controls remain immediate.
+- Hero, initial story, benefits, summaries and contact links are server-rendered. An error boundary contains failures
+  in the story. If client scripts or the enquiry handler are unavailable, the primary action keeps its native contact
+  anchor; the contact section links to the existing contact page.
+- `QualificationPopup` accepts an optional presentation. Without it, the original company form remains unchanged.
+  The homepage uses `subscribeToWaitlist`, the existing `qualification-popup` source, attribution and consent note.
+  It retains drafts on close/failure, validates locally, disables pending edits and fences duplicate submissions.
+  Success uses `/dekujeme?source=autonomous-agendas&lang=cs|en` without contact identity in the URL.
+- The full shared footer retains legal and funding information. Its optional claim and product links affect only
+  callers that supply them. Homepage metadata uses an `agenda` illustration and a page-specific content revision in
+  addition to the shared image version. Authored preview URLs and other pages' artwork are unchanged.
+
+## Preservation
+
+No changes to the company composition/content/metadata, whitepaper sources, root language selector, domain routing
+or deferred September PRD are needed. The legacy company redirect and canonical Czech-only offer remain in place.
+Rendered main text and Open Graph/X/canonical/alternate metadata are compared against the saved pre-change baseline
+for `/cs/pro-firmy`, `/cs/whitepaper` and `/en/whitepaper`. Shared-form preservation also has a browser submission test.
+
+## Verification
+
+Verification results and observed browser measurements are recorded here after the final checks. Browser test
+requests use the real local API with isolated in-memory contacts; failure/retry tests intercept their own requests.
+They do not prove production delivery, physical-device behavior or the availability of the illustrated integrations.

'use client';

import dynamic from 'next/dynamic';
import { ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';
import { useInView, useReducedMotion } from 'framer-motion';
import { useEffect, useReducer, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import type { SupportedHomepageLanguage } from '@/lib/homepage-language';
import { HOMEPAGE_CONTENT } from './homepageContent';
import { HOMEPAGE_SCENARIOS } from './homepageScenarios';
import { homepageStoryReducer, INITIAL_HOMEPAGE_STORY } from './homepageStoryModel';
import { HomepageArtifact, HomepageStatus } from './HomepageArtifact';
import { HomepageEnquiryLink } from './HomepageEnquiryLink';

const HomepageSceneMotion = dynamic(() => import('./HomepageSceneMotion'), { ssr: false });

export default function HomepageStory({ language }: { readonly language: SupportedHomepageLanguage }) {
    const content = HOMEPAGE_CONTENT[language];
    const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(homepageStoryReducer, INITIAL_HOMEPAGE_STORY);
    const [isInteractive, setIsInteractive] = useState(false);
    const [isDocumentVisible, setIsDocumentVisible] = useState(false);
    const sceneReference = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    const isInView = useInView(sceneReference);
    const isReducedMotion = useReducedMotion();
    useEffect(() => {
        setIsInteractive(true);
        const updateVisibility = () => setIsDocumentVisible(document.visibilityState === 'visible');
        updateVisibility();
        document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', updateVisibility);
        return () => document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', updateVisibility);
    }, []);

    const scenario = HOMEPAGE_SCENARIOS[language].find((candidate) => candidate.id === state.scenarioId)!;
    const step = scenario.steps[state.stepIndex];
    const selectStep = (stepIndex: number) => dispatch({ type: 'step', stepIndex });

    return (
        <div
            className="ah-experience"
            data-testid="homepage-story"
            data-scenario={scenario.id}
            data-step={state.stepIndex}
        >
            <div className="ah-scenario-picker" role="group" aria-label={content.story.choose}>
                {HOMEPAGE_SCENARIOS[language].map((candidate, index) => (
                    <button
                        key={candidate.id}
                        type="button"
                        aria-pressed={candidate.id === scenario.id}
                        aria-controls="homepage-story-panel"
                        disabled={!isInteractive}
                        onClick={() => dispatch({ type: 'select', scenarioId: candidate.id })}
                    >
                        <span aria-hidden="true">0{index + 1}</span>
                        {candidate.name}
                    </button>
                ))}
            </div>
            <div id="homepage-story-panel" className="ah-story-panel" ref={sceneReference}>
                <div className="ah-story-copy">
                    <p className="ah-eyebrow">{content.story.scope}</p>
                    <h3>{scenario.benefit}</h3>
                    <p>{scenario.entrusted}</p>
                    <HomepageEnquiryLink className="ah-text-link">{content.cta}</HomepageEnquiryLink>
                </div>
                <HomepageArtifact
                    scenario={scenario}
                    step={step}
                    content={content.story}
                    isInteractive={isInteractive}
                    onStep={selectStep}
                />
                {isInteractive && isInView && isDocumentVisible && !isReducedMotion && (
                    <HomepageSceneMotion sceneReference={sceneReference} />
                )}
            </div>
            <div className="ah-story-bottom">
                <div className="ah-story-steps" role="group" aria-label={content.story.steps}>
                    {scenario.steps.map((candidate, index) => (
                        <button
                            key={index}
                            type="button"
                            disabled={!isInteractive}
                            aria-pressed={index === state.stepIndex}
                            aria-controls="homepage-step-detail"
                            onClick={() => selectStep(index)}
                        >
                            <span>{index + 1}</span>
                            {candidate.label}
                        </button>
                    ))}
                </div>
                <div id="homepage-step-detail" className="ah-step-detail" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true">
                    <div>
                        <HomepageStatus status={step.status}>{step.statusLabel}</HomepageStatus>
                        <h4>{step.title}</h4>
                        <p>{step.description}</p>
                    </div>
                    <div className="ah-step-result">
                        <span>{content.story.result}</span>
                        <strong>{step.result}</strong>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div className="ah-story-toolbar">
                    <span className="ah-demo-label">{content.story.demo}</span>
                    <div className="ah-story-actions">
                        <button
                            type="button"
                            disabled={!isInteractive}
                            onClick={() => dispatch({ type: 'replay' })}
                            aria-label={content.story.replay}
                            title={content.story.replay}
                        >
                            <RotateCcw size={17} aria-hidden="true" />
                        </button>
                        <button
                            type="button"
                            disabled={!isInteractive || state.stepIndex === 0}
                            onClick={() => dispatch({ type: 'previous' })}
                            aria-label={content.story.previous}
                        >
                            <ArrowLeft size={18} aria-hidden="true" />
                        </button>
                        <span className="ah-step-count" aria-hidden="true">
                            {state.stepIndex + 1} / {scenario.steps.length}
                        </span>
                        <button
                            type="button"
                            disabled={!isInteractive || state.stepIndex === scenario.steps.length - 1}
                            onClick={() => dispatch({ type: 'next' })}
                            aria-label={content.story.next}
                        >
                            <ArrowRight size={18} aria-hidden="true" />
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

diff --git a/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md b/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..b821f57938c5853034ac64c8b8007eb79fd73331
--- /dev/null
+++ b/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md
@@ -0,0 +1,49 @@
+# Autonomous agendas homepage
+
+The Czech `/cs` and English `/en` pages present ongoing business responsibilities and an enquiry about deployment.
+The shared composition lives in `businesses/homepage/HomepagePage.tsx`; Czech is the content source of truth.
+The September homepage proposal remains deferred and unchanged.
+
+## Analysis and implementation
+
+Before this change, both routes rendered `ProFirmyPage`, while their metadata already had its own module.
+The company offer owns its document Q&A proposition, shared qualification defaults and canonical `/cs/pro-firmy`
+address. The new homepage therefore has its own content and styles. The whitepaper's semantic controls and CSS
+perspective informed the presentation; none of its chapters, interactions or page styles were replaced.
+
+Whitepaper chapters 1 and 7 supply the shift to ongoing responsibility, chapter 11 supplies the three examples,
+and chapters 10 and 12 supply the approval boundaries and distinction between capabilities and vision. The page
+labels these as fictional illustrations of the direction being developed. It makes no measured customer-result,
+integration-availability, guaranteed-compliance or autonomous-payment claims.
+
+- `homepageScenarios.ts` supplies the interactive stories, readable native-disclosure summaries and enquiry choices.
+  Every scenario has a burden, entrusted responsibility, benefit, owner decision and five finite story moments.
+- `homepageStoryModel.ts` selects one scenario and step. The first view is a prepared result; selecting a scenario
+  resets to that view. Replay returns to the incoming need. Nothing accumulates, runs on a timer or calls a service.
+  Software proposals remain unpublished, customer responses remain unsent, and accounting inputs await review.
+- The layered agent, project and task surfaces are semantic buttons for those same story states. Their grid layout
+  gives text its own space at narrow widths and zoom. Scroll changes only perspective and lift. Its optional controller
+  unmounts offscreen, in a hidden document and for reduced motion. Direct controls remain immediate.
+- Hero, initial story, benefits, summaries and contact links are server-rendered. An error boundary contains failures
+  in the story. If client scripts or the enquiry handler are unavailable, the primary action keeps its native contact
+  anchor; the contact section links to the existing contact page.
+- `QualificationPopup` accepts an optional presentation. Without it, the original company form remains unchanged.
+  The homepage uses `subscribeToWaitlist`, the existing `qualification-popup` source, attribution and consent note.
+  It retains drafts on close/failure, validates locally, disables pending edits and fences duplicate submissions.
+  Success uses `/dekujeme?source=autonomous-agendas&lang=cs|en` without contact identity in the URL.
+- The full shared footer retains legal and funding information. Its optional claim and product links affect only
+  callers that supply them. Homepage metadata uses an `agenda` illustration and a page-specific content revision in
+  addition to the shared image version. Authored preview URLs and other pages' artwork are unchanged.
+
+## Preservation
+
+No changes to the company composition/content/metadata, whitepaper sources, root language selector, domain routing
+or deferred September PRD are needed. The legacy company redirect and canonical Czech-only offer remain in place.
+Rendered main text and Open Graph/X/canonical/alternate metadata are compared against the saved pre-change baseline
+for `/cs/pro-firmy`, `/cs/whitepaper` and `/en/whitepaper`. Shared-form preservation also has a browser submission test.
+
+## Verification
+
+Verification results and observed browser measurements are recorded here after the final checks. Browser test
+requests use the real local API with isolated in-memory contacts; failure/retry tests intercept their own requests.
+They do not prove production delivery, physical-device behavior or the availability of the illustrated integrations.

'use client';

import { GOOGLE_ANALYTICS_ID, META_PIXEL_ID } from '@/config';
import {
    isGoogleAnalyticsAllowed,
    isGoogleAnalyticsPageViewAllowed,
    isThirdPartyTrackingAllowed,
} from '@/lib/tracking/trackingExclusions';
import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation';
import Script from 'next/script';
import spaceTrim from 'spacetrim';

/**
 * Global page analytics. Administration remains fully excluded; the workshop
 * participant room initializes Google Analytics without a page view and sends
 * only explicit anonymous interaction events.
 */
export function Analytics() {
    const pathname = usePathname();
    const isGoogleAnalyticsEnabled = isGoogleAnalyticsAllowed(pathname);
    const isGoogleAnalyticsPageViewEnabled = isGoogleAnalyticsPageViewAllowed(pathname);
    const isMetaPixelEnabled = isThirdPartyTrackingAllowed(pathname);

    if (!isGoogleAnalyticsEnabled && !isMetaPixelEnabled) {
        return null;
    }

    return (
        <>
            {isGoogleAnalyticsEnabled && (
                <>
                    <Script
                        async
                        src={`https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js?id=${GOOGLE_ANALYTICS_ID}`}
                        strategy="afterInteractive"
                    />
                    <Script id="google-analytics" strategy="afterInteractive">
                        {spaceTrim(`
                            console.log('📊 Google Analytics initialized');

                            window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
                            function gtag(){dataLayer.push(arguments);}
                            gtag('js', new Date());
                            gtag('config', '${GOOGLE_ANALYTICS_ID}', { send_page_view: ${isGoogleAnalyticsPageViewEnabled} });
                        `)}
                    </Script>
                </>
            )}

            {isMetaPixelEnabled && (
                <Script id="meta-pixel" strategy="afterInteractive">
                    {spaceTrim(`
                        console.log('📈 Meta Pixel initialized');

                        !function(f,b,e,v,n,t,s)
                        {if(f.fbq)return;n=f.fbq=function(){n.callMethod?
                        n.callMethod.apply(n,arguments):n.queue.push(arguments)};
                        if(!f._fbq)f._fbq=n;n.push=n;n.loaded=!0;n.version='2.0';
                        n.queue=[];t=b.createElement(e);t.async=!0;
                        t.src=v;s=b.getElementsByTagName(e)[0];
                        s.parentNode.insertBefore(t,s)}(window, document,'script',
                        'https://connect.facebook.net/en_US/fbevents.js');
                        fbq('init', '${META_PIXEL_ID}');
                        fbq('track', 'PageView');
                    `)}
                </Script>
            )}
        </>
    );
}
'use client';

import { WorkshopRoomThemeProvider } from '@/components/workshops/WorkshopRoomThemeProvider';
import { PublicSiteNavigationProvider } from '@/components/public-site-navigation-provider';
import { isThirdPartyTrackingAllowed, removeSensitiveTrackingParameters } from '@/lib/tracking/trackingExclusions';
import LogRocket from 'logrocket';
import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation';
import { useEffect } from 'react';

let hasInitializedLogRocket = false;

export function ClientWrapper({ children, publicHostname }: { children: React.ReactNode; publicHostname: string }) {
    const pathname = usePathname();

    useEffect(() => {
        if (hasInitializedLogRocket || !isThirdPartyTrackingAllowed(pathname)) {
            return;
        }

        LogRocket.init('xuy44p/promptbook', {
            shouldSendData: () => isThirdPartyTrackingAllowed(window.location.pathname),
            browser: { urlSanitizer: removeSensitiveTrackingParameters },
            dom: { inputSanitizer: true },
            network: {
                requestSanitizer: (request) =>
                    isThirdPartyTrackingAllowed(window.location.pathname)
                        ? { ...request, url: removeSensitiveTrackingParameters(request.url) }
                        : null,
                responseSanitizer: (response) =>
                    isThirdPartyTrackingAllowed(window.location.pathname)
                        ? {
                              ...response,
                              url: response.url ? removeSensitiveTrackingParameters(response.url) : response.url,
                          }
                        : null,
            },
        });
        hasInitializedLogRocket = true;
    }, [pathname]);

    return (
        <PublicSiteNavigationProvider hostname={publicHostname}>
            <WorkshopRoomThemeProvider>{children}</WorkshopRoomThemeProvider>
        </PublicSiteNavigationProvider>
    );
}
/**
 * What the visitor allowed beyond the cookies the site cannot work without
 */
export type CookiePreferences = {
    readonly isAnalyticsAllowed: boolean;
    readonly isMarketingAllowed: boolean;
};

/**
 * Key under which the browser remembers that the visitor answered the cookie bar at all
 */
const COOKIE_CHOICE_STORAGE_KEY = 'cookiesAccepted';

/**
 * Key under which the browser remembers what exactly the visitor allowed
 */
const COOKIE_PREFERENCES_STORAGE_KEY = 'cookiePreferences';

/**
 * Everything the visitor can allow, which is what the "accept all" button stores
 */
export const ALL_COOKIES_ALLOWED: CookiePreferences = {
    isAnalyticsAllowed: true,
    isMarketingAllowed: true,
};

/**
 * Nothing beyond the necessary cookies, which is where the settings start
 */
export const ONLY_NECESSARY_COOKIES_ALLOWED: CookiePreferences = {
    isAnalyticsAllowed: false,
    isMarketingAllowed: false,
};

/**
 * Tells whether the visitor already answered the cookie bar
 *
 * Note: It is only ever called from an effect, because the server does not know what the browser remembers.
 */
export function isCookieChoiceMade(): boolean {
    return localStorage.getItem(COOKIE_CHOICE_STORAGE_KEY) !== null;
}

/**
 * Remembers what the visitor allowed
 *
 * Note: The stored shape is kept as it was before the preferences got their own type, so a visitor who answered the
 *       bar earlier is not asked again.
 *
 * @param preferences what the visitor allowed
 */
export function saveCookiePreferences(preferences: CookiePreferences): void {
    localStorage.setItem(
        COOKIE_PREFERENCES_STORAGE_KEY,
        JSON.stringify({
            necessary: true,
            analytics: preferences.isAnalyticsAllowed,
            marketing: preferences.isMarketingAllowed,
        }),
    );
    localStorage.setItem(COOKIE_CHOICE_STORAGE_KEY, 'true');
}

+        await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
+        await expect(page.getByRole('dialog')).not.toBeVisible();
+        await expect(page.locator('#hero-cta')).toBeFocused();
+        results[language].isFocusRestored = await page.locator('#hero-cta').evaluate((element) => document.activeElement === element);

+        await page.locator('footer img').evaluateAll((images) => Promise.all(images.map((image) => image.decode())));
+        await page.locator('footer').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-footer.png` });
+        for (const width of [320, 720, 900, 1024]) {
+            await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 900 });
+            expect(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth)).toBe(true);
+        }
+        const imageResponse = await context.request.get(`${BASE_URL}/${language}/opengraph-image?v=2&content=agendas-1`);
+        await fs.writeFile(`${OUTPUT}/${language}-social.png`, await imageResponse.body());
+    }
+    const cookieContext = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 375, height: 812 } });
+    const cookiePage = await cookieContext.newPage();
+    await cookiePage.goto(`${BASE_URL}/cs`);
+    await expect(cookiePage.locator('[data-cookie-consent-panel]')).toBeVisible();
+    await cookiePage.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/cs-cookie-hero.png` });
+    await cookiePage.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo({ top: document.body.scrollHeight, behavior: 'instant' }));
+    await cookiePage.locator('footer img').evaluateAll((images) => Promise.all(images.map((image) => image.decode())));
+    await cookiePage.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/cs-cookie-footer.png` });
+    const footer = await cookiePage.locator('footer').boundingBox();
+    const cookiePanel = await cookiePage.locator('[data-cookie-consent-panel]').boundingBox();
+    results.cookies = { isFooterClear: footer.y + footer.height <= cookiePanel.y, panelHeight: cookiePanel.height };
+    await cookiePage.locator('#hero-cta').click();
+    await expect(cookiePage.getByRole('dialog')).toBeVisible();
+    await cookiePage.getByRole('dialog').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/cs-cookie-form.png` });
+    await fs.writeFile(`${OUTPUT}/measurements.json`, JSON.stringify(results, null, 2));
+    console.log(JSON.stringify(results, null, 2));
+    await browser.close();
+})().catch(async (error) => { console.error(error); await browser?.close(); process.exitCode = 1; });

diff --git a/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md b/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..b821f57938c5853034ac64c8b8007eb79fd73331
--- /dev/null
+++ b/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md
@@ -0,0 +1,49 @@
+# Autonomous agendas homepage
+
+The Czech `/cs` and English `/en` pages present ongoing business responsibilities and an enquiry about deployment.
+The shared composition lives in `businesses/homepage/HomepagePage.tsx`; Czech is the content source of truth.
+The September homepage proposal remains deferred and unchanged.
+
+## Analysis and implementation
+
+Before this change, both routes rendered `ProFirmyPage`, while their metadata already had its own module.
+The company offer owns its document Q&A proposition, shared qualification defaults and canonical `/cs/pro-firmy`
+address. The new homepage therefore has its own content and styles. The whitepaper's semantic controls and CSS
+perspective informed the presentation; none of its chapters, interactions or page styles were replaced.
+
+Whitepaper chapters 1 and 7 supply the shift to ongoing responsibility, chapter 11 supplies the three examples,
+and chapters 10 and 12 supply the approval boundaries and distinction between capabilities and vision. The page
+labels these as fictional illustrations of the direction being developed. It makes no measured customer-result,
+integration-availability, guaranteed-compliance or autonomous-payment claims.
+
+- `homepageScenarios.ts` supplies the interactive stories, readable native-disclosure summaries and enquiry choices.
+  Every scenario has a burden, entrusted responsibility, benefit, owner decision and five finite story moments.
+- `homepageStoryModel.ts` selects one scenario and step. The first view is a prepared result; selecting a scenario
+  resets to that view. Replay returns to the incoming need. Nothing accumulates, runs on a timer or calls a service.
+  Software proposals remain unpublished, customer responses remain unsent, and accounting inputs await review.
+- The layered agent, project and task surfaces are semantic buttons for those same story states. Their grid layout
+  gives text its own space at narrow widths and zoom. Scroll changes only perspective and lift. Its optional controller
+  unmounts offscreen, in a hidden document and for reduced motion. Direct controls remain immediate.
+- Hero, initial story, benefits, summaries and contact links are server-rendered. An error boundary contains failures
+  in the story. If client scripts or the enquiry handler are unavailable, the primary action keeps its native contact
+  anchor; the contact section links to the existing contact page.
+- `QualificationPopup` accepts an optional presentation. Without it, the original company form remains unchanged.
+  The homepage uses `subscribeToWaitlist`, the existing `qualification-popup` source, attribution and consent note.
+  It retains drafts on close/failure, validates locally, disables pending edits and fences duplicate submissions.
+  Success uses `/dekujeme?source=autonomous-agendas&lang=cs|en` without contact identity in the URL.
+- The full shared footer retains legal and funding information. Its optional claim and product links affect only
+  callers that supply them. Homepage metadata uses an `agenda` illustration and a page-specific content revision in
+  addition to the shared image version. Authored preview URLs and other pages' artwork are unchanged.
+
+## Preservation
+
+No changes to the company composition/content/metadata, whitepaper sources, root language selector, domain routing
+or deferred September PRD are needed. The legacy company redirect and canonical Czech-only offer remain in place.
+Rendered main text and Open Graph/X/canonical/alternate metadata are compared against the saved pre-change baseline
+for `/cs/pro-firmy`, `/cs/whitepaper` and `/en/whitepaper`. Shared-form preservation also has a browser submission test.
+
+## Verification
+
+Verification results and observed browser measurements are recorded here after the final checks. Browser test
+requests use the real local API with isolated in-memory contacts; failure/retry tests intercept their own requests.
+They do not prove production delivery, physical-device behavior or the availability of the illustrated integrations.

+                                        rectangle.right > task.left &&
+                                        rectangle.top < task.bottom &&
+                                        rectangle.bottom > task.top,
+                                );
+                                return isCovered ? [artifact.textContent] : [];
+                            });
+                        });
+                        expect(coveredText, `${width}px / ${scenario.id} / ${step.label}`).toEqual([]);

+const { chromium, expect: baseExpect } = require('@playwright/test');
+const expect = baseExpect.configure({ timeout: 60000 });

+
+const BASE_URL = process.env.HOMEPAGE_REVIEW_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:4010';
+const OUTPUT = '.tmp/homepage-final-review';
+let browser;
+
+(async () => {
+    await fs.mkdir(OUTPUT, { recursive: true });
+    browser = await chromium.launch();

+    await context.addInitScript(() => {
+        localStorage.setItem('cookiesAccepted', 'true');
+        localStorage.setItem('cookiePreferences', JSON.stringify({ necessary: true, analytics: false, marketing: false }));
+        window.homepageReview = { layoutShift: 0, longTasks: [], largestContentfulPaint: 0 };
+        new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
+            for (const entry of list.getEntries()) if (!entry.hadRecentInput) window.homepageReview.layoutShift += entry.value;
+        }).observe({ type: 'layout-shift', buffered: true });
+        new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
+            window.homepageReview.longTasks.push(...list.getEntries().map((entry) => entry.duration));
+        }).observe({ type: 'longtask', buffered: true });
+        new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
+            window.homepageReview.largestContentfulPaint = list.getEntries().at(-1).startTime;
+        }).observe({ type: 'largest-contentful-paint', buffered: true });
+    });
+    const page = await context.newPage();
+    page.on('pageerror', (error) => console.error('Browser error:', error.message));
+    const results = {};
+    for (const language of ['cs', 'en']) {
+        await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1440, height: 1000 });
+        await page.goto(`${BASE_URL}/${language}`, { timeout: 180000 });
+        await expect(page.locator('.ah-scenario-picker button').first()).toBeEnabled();
+        await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
+        await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-desktop.png`, fullPage: true });
+        results[language] = { desktop: await page.evaluate(() => ({ ...window.homepageReview,
+            scriptBytes: performance.getEntriesByType('resource').filter((entry) => entry.initiatorType === 'script').reduce((sum, entry) => sum + entry.encodedBodySize, 0),
+            firstContentfulPaint: performance.getEntriesByName('first-contentful-paint')[0]?.startTime,
+        })) };
+        await page.locator('#agendas').scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+        await expect.poll(() => page.locator('.ah-story-panel').evaluate((element) => element.style.getPropertyValue('--ah-tilt'))).not.toBe('');
+        const before = await page.locator('.ah-scene-stack').evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).transform);
+        await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollBy({ top: 180, behavior: 'instant' }));
+        await expect.poll(() => page.locator('.ah-scene-stack').evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).transform)).not.toBe(before);
+        results[language].isScrollDepthChanged = true;
+        await page.setViewportSize({ width: 375, height: 812 });
+        await page.goto(`${BASE_URL}/${language}`);
+        await expect(page.locator('.ah-scenario-picker button').first()).toBeEnabled();
+        await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
+        await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-hero.png` });
+        results[language].phone = await page.evaluate(() => ({ ...window.homepageReview,
+            firstContentfulPaint: performance.getEntriesByName('first-contentful-paint')[0]?.startTime,
+        }));
+        const heights = [];
+        for (let scenario = 0; scenario < 3; scenario++) {
+            await page.locator('.ah-scenario-picker button').nth(scenario).tap();
+            await page.locator('.ah-scene').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-example-${scenario}.png` });
+            for (let step = 0; step < 5; step++) {
+                await page.locator('.ah-story-steps button').nth(step).tap();
+                heights.push(Math.round((await page.locator('.ah-experience').boundingBox()).height));
+            }
+        }
+        results[language].phoneStoryHeightRange = [Math.min(...heights), Math.max(...heights)];
+        await page.locator('#hero-cta').click();
+        await page.getByRole('dialog').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-form-top.png` });
+        await page.getByRole('dialog').locator('form > p').last().scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+        await page.getByRole('dialog').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-form-bottom.png` });
+        await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
+        await expect(page.getByRole('dialog')).not.toBeVisible();
+        await expect(page.locator('#hero-cta')).toBeFocused();
+        results[language].isFocusRestored = await page.locator('#hero-cta').evaluate((element) => document.activeElement === element);
+        await page.locator('footer').scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+        await page.locator('footer img').evaluateAll((images) => Promise.all(images.map((image) => image.decode())));
+        await page.locator('footer').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT}/${language}-phone-footer.png` });
+        for (const width of [320, 720, 900, 1024]) {

+        }
+        const imageResponse = await context.request.get(`${BASE_URL}/${language}/opengraph-image?v=2&content=agendas-1`);

+    }
+    const cookieContext = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 375, height: 812 } });
+    const cookiePage = await cookieContext.newPage();

+    console.log(JSON.stringify(results, null, 2));
+    await browser.close();
+})().catch(async (error) => { console.error(error); await browser?.close(); process.exitCode = 1; });

diff --git a/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md b/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..b821f57938c5853034ac64c8b8007eb79fd73331
--- /dev/null
+++ b/docs/autonomous-agendas-homepage.md
@@ -0,0 +1,49 @@
+# Autonomous agendas homepage
+
+The Czech `/cs` and English `/en` pages present ongoing business responsibilities and an enquiry about deployment.
+The shared composition lives in `businesses/homepage/HomepagePage.tsx`; Czech is the content source of truth.
+The September homepage proposal remains deferred and unchanged.
+
+## Analysis and implementation
+
+Before this change, both routes rendered `ProFirmyPage`, while their metadata already had its own module.
+The company offer owns its document Q&A proposition, shared qualification defaults and canonical `/cs/pro-firmy`
+address. The new homepage therefore has its own content and styles. The whitepaper's semantic controls and CSS
+perspective informed the presentation; none of its chapters, interactions or page styles were replaced.
+
+Whitepaper chapters 1 and 7 supply the shift to ongoing responsibility, chapter 11 supplies the three examples,
+and chapters 10 and 12 supply the approval boundaries and distinction between capabilities and vision. The page
+labels these as fictional illustrations of the direction being developed. It makes no measured customer-result,
+integration-availability, guaranteed-compliance or autonomous-payment claims.
+
+- `homepageScenarios.ts` supplies the interactive stories, readable native-disclosure summaries and enquiry choices.
+  Every scenario has a burden, entrusted responsibility, benefit, owner decision and five finite story moments.
+- `homepageStoryModel.ts` selects one scenario and step. The first view is a prepared result; selecting a scenario
+  resets to that view. Replay returns to the incoming need. Nothing accumulates, runs on a timer or calls a service.
+  Software proposals remain unpublished, customer responses remain unsent, and accounting inputs await review.
+- The layered agent, project and task surfaces are semantic buttons for those same story states. Their grid layout
+  gives text its own space at narrow widths and zoom. Scroll changes only perspective and lift. Its optional controller
+  unmounts offscreen, in a hidden document and for reduced motion. Direct controls remain immediate.
+- Hero, initial story, benefits, summaries and contact links are server-rendered. An error boundary contains failures
+  in the story. If client scripts or the enquiry handler are unavailable, the primary action keeps its native contact
+  anchor; the contact section links to the existing contact page.
+- `QualificationPopup` accepts an optional presentation. Without it, the original company form remains unchanged.
+  The homepage uses `subscribeToWaitlist`, the existing `qualification-popup` source, attribution and consent note.
+  It retains drafts on close/failure, validates locally, disables pending edits and fences duplicate submissions.
+  Success uses `/dekujeme?source=autonomous-agendas&lang=cs|en` without contact identity in the URL.
+- The full shared footer retains legal and funding information. Its optional claim and product links affect only
+  callers that supply them. Homepage metadata uses an `agenda` illustration and a page-specific content revision in
+  addition to the shared image version. Authored preview URLs and other pages' artwork are unchanged.
+
+## Preservation
+
+No changes to the company composition/content/metadata, whitepaper sources, root language selector, domain routing
+or deferred September PRD are needed. The legacy company redirect and canonical Czech-only offer remain in place.
+Rendered main text and Open Graph/X/canonical/alternate metadata are compared against the saved pre-change baseline
+for `/cs/pro-firmy`, `/cs/whitepaper` and `/en/whitepaper`. Shared-form preservation also has a browser submission test.
+
+## Verification
+
+Verification results and observed browser measurements are recorded here after the final checks. Browser test
+requests use the real local API with isolated in-memory contacts; failure/retry tests intercept their own requests.
+They do not prove production delivery, physical-device behavior or the availability of the illustrated integrations.
